descriptionPlain:
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators.
Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is self-motivated, product-minded, and technically rigorous to join our Storefront Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to build a high-quality, white-label Android game store from the ground up, tackling complex challenges in large-game distribution, download management, and multi-tenant theming.
 
Strong Kotlin and modern Android development skills are essential, along with experience in native Android development, particularly with large-file downloaders, app stores, or content distribution systems. The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, design, backend, and QA) and drive technical decisions will be key to your success in this role.

If you’re passionate about creating high-performance, feature-rich consumer-facing applications and love solving the unique technical challenges of distributing and updating large-scale Android games, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Design, build, and maintain the Android client for the game store, using Kotlin + Jetpack Compose to deliver a modern, high-performance UI.

  • Implement core features: game browsing, categories, search and filtering, game detail pages, user accounts, game library, ratings and reviews.

  • Design and implement the game download, install, and update management module (resumable downloads, guided/silent installation, signature verification, version management).

  • Implement white-label theming and multi-channel build capabilities (via Gradle product flavors and/or runtime theme configuration) to support per-partner branding.

  • Optimize app performance (e.g. startup time), stability (e.g. crash rate), binary size, and memory usage.

  • Collaborate closely with product owner, designer, backend dev, and QA; contribute to technical design and code reviews.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; enforce coding standards and participate in peer code reviews.

  • Game industry experience required
  • On-site position only (remote work not available)

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of native Android development experience.

  • Strong command of Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow for asynchronous programming (or mastery of Java and its equivalents).

  • Proficient with Jetpack Compose for declarative UI development (traditional View/XML experience is a plus).

  • Familiar with Android Jetpack components (ViewModel, Lifecycle, Room, Navigation, Hilt) and MVVM/MVI architecture.

  • Familiar with common libraries: networking (Retrofit/OkHttp), image loading (Coil/Glide), and local storage.

  • Familiar with the Gradle build system, including white-label / multi-tenant / multi-flavor builds, signing, and version management.

  • Solid understanding of Android’s installation mechanisms, permission model, and behavioral changes across OS versions.

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: coding standards, unit testing, and version control (GitLab/GitHub).

  • Proficiency with AI coding tools to boost development productivity.

• Understanding of the Chinese gaming industry, game app characteristics, and player needs.

  • Experience in game development, publishing, or operations on major Chinese gaming platforms.

  • Familiarity with the Android package structure exported by game engines such as Unity / Unreal (APK + OBB expansion files, large asset bundles).

  • Experience integrating game SDKs (account login, in-app purchases, ad monetization, analytics, real-name verification).

    • Note: Less experienced candidates could be considered as middle-level developers.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and maintain the backend services for the game distribution platform, with a highly available and scalable server-side architecture

  • Design and implement a multi-tenant architecture supporting data isolation

  • Design and implement the storage and delivery solution for large game files (object storage / CDN, signed download URLs, resumable downloads, version management)

  • Build backend APIs and permission systems for the operations admin panel and publisher portal

  • Design and deliver the search solution (e.g., Elasticsearch) to power full-text search and filtering of games

  • Ensure system performance, concurrency, security, and observability (monitoring, logging, alerting)

  • Game industry experience required
  • On-site position only (remote work not available)

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong command of GoLang

  • Proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, etc.)

  • Solid RESTful API design skills; familiar with microservice architecture

  • Familiar with relational database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) design and optimization; knowledge of NoSQL (Redis, etc.)

  • Familiar with message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), caching, and other middleware

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: coding standards, unit testing, Git, CI/CD

• Understanding of the Chinese gaming industry and experience in Chinese game building, publishing, or operation on major Chinese gaming platforms

  • Experience in backend development for games or game platforms

  • Familiarity with server-side integration of game SDKs (accounts, in-app purchases, real-name verification)

  • Familiarity with in-app purchase (IAP), virtual goods, and order management

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS / white-label platform architecture

  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch

  • Experience designing and optimizing high-concurrency, high-traffic systems

  • Experience with app stores or content/game distribution platforms

  • Knowledge of object storage and CDN, with experience in or awareness of large-file / high-concurrency delivery

    • Note: Less experienced candidate could be considered as middle-level developer.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

 

 

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for an Account Executive — Gaming/Adtech Sales who is relationship-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply immersed in China's gaming and digital advertising ecosystem to join our Revenue & Partnerships team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pitching through to close — across a diverse book of gaming advertisers and publishers across China and the broader APAC market.

Strong commercial acumen and communication skills are essential, along with experience in digital advertising sales, performance marketing, or gaming monetization within the Chinese market. The ability to build enduring client relationships grounded in trust, navigate China's complex and fast-moving digital advertising landscape, and manage multi-stakeholder deal structures will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about the intersection of gaming and advertising technology and love building innovative ad solutions that help game developers grow their player base and revenue across the world's largest gaming market, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
Responsibilities:

  • Own the full sales cycle for gaming ad sales accounts across China and the APAC region — from prospecting and outreach through pitch, negotiation, and close, with a strong focus on relationship cultivation consistent with Chinese business practices

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based, long-term relationships with game developers, publishers, and advertising agencies, acting as the primary point of contact for Xsolla's ad monetization solutions in the Chinese market

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities by leveraging existing networks, attending industry events, and proactively targeting key accounts within China's gaming and advertising ecosystem

  • Develop tailored account plans and pitch materials that align client goals with Xsolla's product offerings, including offerwall, rewarded ads, and performance-based monetization tools, localized appropriately for the Chinese market

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with global product, marketing, and partner success teams to ensure client campaigns are delivered effectively and meet performance targets

  • Monitor campaign performance, provide clients with regular reporting and insights in both Mandarin and English, and proactively recommend optimizations to maximize results and retention

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and account details in CRM (Salesforce)

  • Represent Xsolla at key gaming and ad tech conferences and trade events across China and APAC (e.g., China Joy, Game Connection Asia, Pocket Gamer Connects, WePlay Expo)

  • Provide market intelligence on advertiser trends, competitor activity, platform developments, and emerging opportunities across China's gaming and digital advertising markets

    •  

     

    Qualifications and Skills:

    • 3+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, ad tech, gaming monetization, or a closely related field within the Chinese market

    • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and managing a full sales cycle, including experience navigating China's relationship-driven (guanxi-based) enterprise sales environment

    • Strong understanding of performance advertising models (CPI, CPA, CPM) and the mobile gaming ecosystem, with familiarity with China's major publishers and platforms (Tencent, NetEase, miHoYo, ByteDance/TikTok, Bilibili, Kuaishou, Baidu)

    • Native or business-level proficiency in Mandarin Chinese, with strong working proficiency in English — the ability to operate fluently across both languages in client-facing and internal communications is essential

    • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills with a strong understanding of Chinese business culture, including relationship-building norms, hierarchy, and enterprise decision-making dynamics

    • Proficiency in CRM software (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales tooling, as well as familiarity with Chinese business communication platforms (WeChat, DingTalk)

    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously and adapt quickly to China's rapidly evolving regulatory and platform environment

    • Based in or willing to relocate to Beijing, China; eligible to work in China without visa sponsorship

      •  

       

      Nice to Have:

      • Experience working with offerwall, rewarded video, or user acquisition advertising products within the Chinese mobile gaming space

      • Established network within China's games industry — publishers, studios, ad agencies, or platform partners (WeChat Mini Games, Douyin, Kuaishou, Huawei AppGallery, TapTap)

      • Familiarity with mobile game monetization metrics (ARPU, LTV, ROAS, D7/D30 retention) and China-specific monetization trends such as gacha mechanics, battle pass models, and live-service content strategies

        •

lists.content:
• Partner and collaborate with senior engineers to identify where AI tooling and integrations can remove friction, and build the fix.

  • Build applications and integrations on top of Xsolla's APIs and SDKs that show internal teams how to move faster using AI-assisted development.

  • Ship work that matters. What you build is expected to reach real users – whether that's an internal tool an engineering team adopts or a customer-facing integration – not a throwaway exercise that gets shelved after your internship ends.

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working – not a novelty you reach for occasionally.

  • Share what you build. We run weekly 30-second lightning-talk demos where everyone shows how they used AI to solve something that week – you'll be expected to bring something real.

  • Work with minimal process. You'll get context, a problem, and a mentor – the rest is on you to figure out and build.

  • Learn from and collaborate with both directions: senior engineers who'll mentor you on production-grade practices, and fellow interns across markets you'll trade ideas and code with at the weekly demos.

You build things because you want to, and that you already use AI to do it faster.

  • Genuine passion for building. You have side projects, hackathon entries, open-source contributions, or something you shipped just because you were curious. You didn't need an assignment to make it happen.

  • Real AI fluency. You've actually used tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar agentic coding tools to build something – not just asked ChatGPT to explain a concept. You should be able to explain how you used AI to get there and how you confirmed it actually worked – not someone who fires off a prompt and hopes for the best.

  • Bias toward action. Given an ambiguous problem, you start building before you ask for a spec.

  • Comfort with developing modern full-stack solutions – we care more about how fast you learn than what you already know cold.

  • Open to current graduate students and recent graduates of a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related program.

Please include:

  1. A link to a GitHub profile, deployed project, or anything else you've built – the more recent and self-directed, the better.

  2. A short answer (2-3 sentences, or a 2-minute video/Loom if you'd rather show than tell) to: “What's something hard you built recently, and why did you build it?”

We're not grading for correctness or polish. We're looking for whether you have a real answer, and whether it's clear you actually did the work yourself (with AI as your tool, not your ghostwriter).

About Xsolla
Xsolla is a global commerce and financial technology company for the video game industry. Headquartered in Los Angeles with offices and operations worldwide, Xsolla provides the tools, infrastructure and capital solutions that help developers and publishers fund, launch, distribute and monetize their games across every market and platform. The company serves thousands of game businesses globally, from independent studios to the largest publishers, and is expanding a dedicated capital markets and investment platform serving the interactive entertainment ecosystem.
The Capital Markets Group
The Capital Markets Group (CMG) sits within Xsolla's Global Strategic Initiatives function and operates as the firm's institutional capital platform. The group originates, structures and executes financing and investment solutions across games and interactive entertainment, and is building a franchise modeled on the leading independent capital markets and special situations advisory platforms.
The group operates multiple investment vehicles spanning debt financing and credit markets, alongside special situations and principal investment strategies serving the interactive entertainment ecosystem. These activities are supported by a proprietary market intelligence system, a global events and convening program, and a governed institutional relationship platform covering LPs, sovereign investors, family offices, banks and intermediaries across the Americas, MENA, APAC and Europe.
CMG operates from hubs in Los Angeles, New York, the Middle East and Singapore. The group is in its foundation stage: hires at every level join a live deal environment with executive sponsorship, meaningful ownership and the mandate to build a durable franchise rather than inherit one.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

About the Opportunity

Xsolla is seeking an Analyst, Capital Markets Intelligence and CRM to operate the information layer that the entire Capital Markets Group runs on: producing the daily market intelligence that directs senior coverage attention, building and maintaining the institutional relationship data that every mandate draws on, tracking the global events landscape that drives origination, and preparing the briefing materials that put senior coverage into every meeting fully prepared.

The corporate title for this seat is Analyst, with no direct reports. The seat offers unusual breadth for the level: direct exposure to fund formation, private placements, and credit and distressed situations across gaming and interactive entertainment, daily interaction with the group's senior leadership, and a defined development path toward coverage or capital formation responsibility.

The Analyst, Capital Markets Intelligence and CRM will be based in Los Angeles, CA, Xsolla's headquarters, in office, and will report to the Vice President, Investor Relations and Capital Formation. Travel is limited to up to 10 percent, primarily for priority industry events. This is a full time position.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should apply via the application button below, together with a resume and a short note on relevant experience. The Xsolla Talent Acquisition team will follow up on qualifying applications.

Role Overview

As Analyst, Capital Markets Intelligence and CRM, you will run the information systems that the entire Capital Markets Group depends on: the daily intelligence product, the institutional relationship database, the events calendar, and the meeting preparation that keeps senior coverage armed for every conversation. The role suits a candidate who wants the analytical rigor of an investment banking seat combined with real ownership of a system they run themselves.

Key Responsibilities

Market Intelligence

  • Produce the daily digest. Produce the daily capital markets intelligence digests and the Friday weekly rollup, applying the group's prioritization rubric and tiered output formats for individual, team and executive audiences, and operate the reader feedback loop that tunes the product over time.

  • Monitor global sources. Monitor the defined multilingual source set with translation tooling and flag regionally significant items to the Americas, MENA and APAC coverage heads.

  • Track special situations. Track the distressed and special situations landscape across gaming and interactive entertainment, and prepare screening one pagers on qualifying situations for review at the weekly pipeline call.

    • Relationship Data Operations

    • Build institutional records. Build institutional records in the firm's relationship platform, sourcing from public materials, licensed data providers and event lists, with enrichment, deduplication and tiering support to the group's data standards.

    • Operate the staging workflow. Operate the prospect staging and promotion workflow, ensuring nothing enters the production database without review, and support the quarterly tiering refresh.

    • Maintain the audit trail. Maintain the audit trail on data provenance and consent context consistent with the firm's data handling standard.

      • Coverage Support

      • Prepare meeting briefs. Prepare meeting briefs for every Tier 1 interaction at least 24 hours in advance, including institution profile, relationship history, live items and suggested talking points; log outcomes and next actions in the platform after each meeting.

      • Support materials preparation. Support materials preparation for investor meetings, roadshows and transaction processes under the direction of the VP and coverage heads.

        • Events and Convening

        • Maintain the events calendar. Maintain the global events calendar across credit, private capital, SPAC, venture, family office and sovereign conferences, with rolling 30, 60 and 90 day action lists and attendance recommendations.

        • Run event follow up. Run event follow up operations, capturing who the team met, promoting qualified contacts into the platform and tracking post event actions to completion.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in investment banking, equity or credit research, management consulting, or a data intensive operations seat at a financial institution; exceptional final year candidates and recent graduates with relevant internships will be considered.

  • Working knowledge of the gaming and interactive entertainment ecosystems is a plus, as is exposure to data providers such as Preqin, PitchBook or Bloomberg.

    • Domain Expertise

    • Excellent research and business writing skills, with the ability to compress large volumes of information into decision ready summaries.

    • Familiarity with Salesforce administration concepts, SQL, or automation tooling used to build workflows is preferred.

      • Skills and Competencies

      • Strong working proficiency in Excel and demonstrated comfort operating CRM or comparable structured data systems, with accountability for data quality.

      • Meticulous attention to detail, high throughput, and the judgment to distinguish signal from noise under time pressure.

      • Discretion with confidential information and a high degree of ethics and integrity.

      • Professional working proficiency in one or more of Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Portuguese or Spanish is preferred.

        • Education and Credentials

        • A bachelor's degree is required.

        • The SIE examination, passed or scheduled, is preferred; Xsolla sponsors relevant professional examinations and designations as part of its analyst development program.

With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
 
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase.
You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets.
This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Build partner integrations
Build and maintain backend services that power Traffic Source partnerships: affiliate and referral link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution parameter pass-through, server-to-server postbacks and webhooks, and partner-facing reporting endpoints.
Take new partnerships inquiries from intake through to production — clarify the requirement with the Partnerships and BD teams, write the technical spec, implement, test, and deploy.
Integrate affiliate links with Xsolla Web Shops so partner-driven traffic is tracked end to end and attributed correctly at checkout.
Read a partner's API documentation and build against it; where a partner needs to build against us, document our side clearly and support their integration.
Tooling & data
Build internal tooling and scripts for partner onboarding, bulk link generation, performance data extraction, and payout reconciliation reporting used by the Customer Success and Partnerships teams.
Investigate and resolve attribution and tracking discrepancies together with Analytics and Customer Success — missing conversions, duplicate events, broken parameters, timing mismatches.
Add logging, metrics, and alerting so integration failures are caught by us rather than reported by a partner.
Ways of working
Write and maintain API documentation and integration guides for partners and internal stakeholders.
Participate in code review, write tests, and work within existing CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows.
Work with the HQ Engineering and Integration Management teams on standards and architecture; escalate design decisions early rather than working around them.
Collaborate closely with the Partnerships Designer on the frontend surfaces your integrations power, and with Customer Success on the payout data your services produce.
Track work in Jira and keep technical documentation current in Confluence.
REQUIREMENTS
1–4 years of professional backend development experience, or a strong portfolio of personal, academic, or internship projects you can walk us through. Recent graduates are welcome.
Working proficiency in at least one backend language — Go, PHP, Python, Node.js / TypeScript, or Java.
Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals (schema design, joins, indexing basics).
Good understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and API authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0).
Comfortable with Git and working in a code-review culture.
Able to debug a problem you did not write — read logs, reproduce, isolate, and explain the cause.
English sufficient for technical discussion and written documentation with HQ teams; Russian for day-to-day work in the Vladivostok office.
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Vladivostok for an onsite role.
NICE TO HAVE
Exposure to affiliate or performance marketing technology: tracking pixels, S2S postbacks, click IDs and UTM parameters, last-click attribution, deduplication, or traffic-quality and fraud filtering.
E-commerce, storefront, checkout, or payments integration experience.
Frontend basics (JavaScript / TypeScript, React) — enough to work productively with the Partnerships Designer on shop and landing-page surfaces.
Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS).
Message queues, scheduled jobs, or data pipeline experience.
Familiarity with analytics or BI tooling.
Interest in the gaming industry, fintech, or high-load consumer platforms.
BENEFITS
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase.
You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets.
This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. Build partner integrations

Take new partnerships inquiries from intake through to production — clarify the requirement with the Partnerships and BD teams, write the technical spec, implement, test, and deploy.
Integrate affiliate links with Xsolla Web Shops so partner-driven traffic is tracked end to end and attributed correctly at checkout.
Read a partner's API documentation and build against it; where a partner needs to build against us, document our side clearly and support their integration.
Tooling & data
Build internal tooling and scripts for partner onboarding, bulk link generation, performance data extraction, and payout reconciliation reporting used by the Customer Success and Partnerships teams.
Investigate and resolve attribution and tracking discrepancies together with Analytics and Customer Success — missing conversions, duplicate events, broken parameters, timing mismatches.
Add logging, metrics, and alerting so integration failures are caught by us rather than reported by a partner.

Write and maintain API documentation and integration guides for partners and internal stakeholders.
Participate in code review, write tests, and work within existing CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows.
Work with the HQ Engineering and Integration Management teams on standards and architecture; escalate design decisions early rather than working around them.
Collaborate closely with the Partnerships Designer on the frontend surfaces your integrations power, and with Customer Success on the payout data your services produce.
Track work in Jira and keep technical documentation current in Confluence.

descriptionBody:
ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Business Development Manager who is strategically driven, relationship-focused, and deeply passionate about the gaming and payments landscape to join our Japan team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to identify and lead high-value partnerships, expand Xsolla's presence in the Japanese market, and serve as a trusted advisor to top-tier game studios and publishers.

Strong negotiation skills and the ability to close complex, high-value deals are essential, along with experience in business development or strategic partnerships within the payments and/or gaming industry. The ability to manage multiple high-priority relationships, navigate cross-functional collaboration, and communicate effectively with stakeholders from C-level executives to technical counterparts will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about driving meaningful growth through strategic partnerships and innovative commerce solutions and love helping game developers in Japan and across APAC unlock new revenue opportunities and reach more players worldwide, we would love to hear from you!


ABOUT US
 
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
 
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

lists.content:
Design & Construction Supervision (pre-opening)

  • Supervise the execution of the approved design project, including all construction, fit-out, and finishing works

  • Ensure all works comply with Xsolla internal design guidelines and brand standards; escalate and resolve deviations before they become permanent

  • Coordinate contractors, subcontractors, and site schedules; track progress against timelines, budget, and quality expectations

  • Manage snag lists, technical acceptance, and formal handover of the completed space

  • Maintain full documentation of the project: drawings, approvals, change requests, certificates, and warranties

    • Day-to-Day Club Operations (post-opening) 

    • Own the daily operation of the Club: opening and closing procedures, access control, space readiness, and general upkeep

    • Oversee maintenance, cleaning, technical systems (HVAC, AV, IT infrastructure, security), and preventative servicing

    • Manage room and space bookings, capacity planning, and the operational calendar

    • Act as the first point of contact for anything related to the physical space

      • Supplies, Vendors & Procurement

      • Control all supplies and inventory: office and hospitality consumables, F&B, equipment, and event materials

      • Source, onboard, and manage vendors and service providers; negotiate terms and monitor performance

      • Handle purchase requests, contracts, invoices, and reconciliation in line with internal finance procedures

      • Track and report operational spend against the approved Club budget

        • Authorities, Landlord & Regulatory Affairs

        • Serve as the primary liaison with local authorities and their representatives

        • Lead or support negotiations with the landlord and building management on lease matters, works approvals, service charges, and access

        • Obtain and maintain all required permits, licences, inspections, and certificates for the venue and its activities

        • Ensure continuous compliance with Cypriot local regulations, including health and safety, fire safety, accessibility, and any licensing relevant to events and hospitality

          • Events Coordination

          • Coordinate all events hosted at the Club — meetups, workshops, partner sessions, community nights, and corporate hosting in collaboration with Event Manager

          • Handle end-to-end event logistics: setup and teardown, AV and technical needs, catering, staffing, guest registration, and access

          • Coordinate with internal marketing, community, and business development teams, and with external organisers and sponsors

          • Be present on-site during events as the operational owner; resolve issues in real time

          • Produce post-event summaries covering attendance, costs, issues, and recommendations

            • Compliance, Process & Reporting

            • Ensure all Club activity aligns with Xsolla internal rules, policies, and procedures

            • Maintain accurate operational records, vendor documentation, and compliance files

            • Provide regular reporting on operations, spend, events, and any risks or open issues to the Club Director and regional leadership

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in an administrative, office management, facility management, or events management role — ideally a combination of these

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating vendors, suppliers, or contractors

  • Experience interacting with landlords, building management, or public authorities

  • Exposure to construction, fit-out, or renovation project supervision is a strong advantage

    • Languages

    • English — mandatory (professional working proficiency)

    • Greek — mandatory (professional working proficiency)

    • Russian — advantageous, not required

      • Skills & Attributes

      • Strong organisational skills and the ability to run multiple parallel workstreams without dropping details

      • Confident, professional communicator — comfortable holding vendors and contractors accountable

      • Practical problem-solver with a bias toward resolving issues on the spot

      • Comfortable with budgets, invoices, and basic financial tracking

      • Working knowledge of the Cypriot regulatory and permitting landscape

      • Flexible availability, including occasional evenings and weekends for events

      • Eligible to work in Cyprus

        •  

        Nice to Have

        • Familiarity with the gaming, tech, or startup community in Cyprus

        • Background in hospitality, coworking, cultural venues, or member clubs

        • Experience working within an international company and its internal procedures

          • What Success Looks Like

          First 3 months: The build-out is progressing on schedule and on budget, fully aligned with Xsolla design guidelines. All permits and approvals required for opening are secured or clearly tracked. Vendor framework is in place.

          First 6 months: The Club is open and operating smoothly. Operational routines, supplier relationships, and compliance documentation are established and running without escalation. The first events have been delivered successfully.

          Ongoing: The Club is a reliably well-run, on-brand space that the community and internal teams trust — with clean compliance, controlled costs, and events that run without friction.

• Create and drive the Japan marketing strategy end-to-end — brand, demand generation, field marketing, content, customer marketing, developer marketing, and partner marketing — aligned with global priorities and Japan and regional objectives.
  • Build, lead, and mentor the marketing team in Japan, establishing the structure, capabilities, and operating rhythms needed to scale marketing execution as the business grows.
  • Build and operate the marketing budget, including planning, allocation, agency/vendor management, and performance measurement and reporting against clear ROI and pipeline metrics.
  • Partner closely with the Japan Country Manager, GTM/BD leadership, Product Marketing, Comms, Events, and Global HQ marketing to deliver integrated programs that support enterprise adoption, partner growth, and revenue targets.
  • Translate and localize global B2B narratives, product launches, and brand strategy into Japan-relevant campaigns, executive and customer events, customer proof points, and sales enablement materials.
  • Serve as the senior Japan voice for marketing internally and externally — bringing market insight, customer and publisher perspective, and local nuance into regional and global leadership discussions, and influencing global strategy where Japan market dynamics diverge.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key Japanese publishers, developers, and industry bodies, elevating Xsolla's visibility and credibility across the Japan gaming ecosystem.
  • Represent Xsolla at major global, regional and local video game development industry events and forums, and oversee Xsolla's presence, sponsorships, and thought leadership in the local market.
  • Establish and continuously improve marketing operating rhythms in Japan — planning cycles, event execution, vendor/agency management, and reporting cadence with global and regional stakeholders.

• 12+ years of marketing experience, including 7+ years in B2B marketing leadership roles, ideally within technology, video games, platforms, or high-growth environments.
  • Proven track record building and leading a marketing function from the ground up, including team building, budget ownership, and cross-functional program delivery in Japan, regional or similarly complex markets.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying dynamics in Japan and throughout Asia including the role of trust, regulation, partners, executive relationships, and local proof points.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and executional levels, comfortable setting vision while remaining hands-on in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Experience leading and influencing in a matrixed organization, working closely with Country/GTM leadership, BD, Partnerships, Product Marketing, Comms, Events, and global HQ marketing.
  • Excellent communicator and executive presence, with business-level (or native-level) Japanese and native-level English proficiency, and strong stakeholder management and influence skills across Japan leadership, regional marketing, and global teams.
  • Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors, major industry events, and field/demand generation programs at a country or regional level.
  • Strong external network and credibility within the Japan gaming, technology, or platform industry.

• Experience in video games, fintech, developer platforms, or other highly technical products.
  • Familiarity with trust-sensitive enterprise environments and regulated industries.
  • Prior experience as a CMO, VP Marketing, or country/regional marketing head with full P&L or budget accountability.
  • Existing relationships with major Japanese game publishers, developers, or industry associations.

lists.content:
Marketplace & Homepage Ownership

  • Execute the content and placement plan across x.la and Xsolla Mall homepage and marketplace surfaces, as directed by Marketing, BD, and Product stakeholders.

  • Maintain the operational content programming roadmap, translating strategic priorities from Marketing, BD, and Product into actionable live-ops timelines.

  • Translate launches, campaigns, and partner initiatives into clear marketplace programming for execution.

  • Ensure alignment with leadership on priorities and trade-offs.

    • Content Operations & Live Ops

  • Manage day-to-day live operations across homepage tiles, featured placements, storefronts, and promotional modules.

  • Maintain content freshness, cadence, and quality across all marketplace surfaces.

  • Coordinate campaign launches and updates, including scheduling, QA, and go-live execution.

  • Work with stakeholders on a content calendar, planning out updates over time.

  • Work closely with Ops and Product teams to execute within existing CMS and tooling constraints.

  • Manage localization of landing pages and promotional assets with regional teams to ensure accurate and market-relevant content delivery.

    • Cross-Functional Coordination & Prioritization

  • Serve as the main point of contact for marketplace content execution requests from Marketing, BD, and other stakeholders.

  • Consult stakeholders to understand operational objectives, then own prioritization and sequencing of live-ops content.

  • Proactively flag conflicts, capacity risks, and trade-offs, ensuring leadership alignment.

    • Performance & Optimization

  • Provide operational tracking for live content, reporting on immediate performance indicators such as:

  • CTR and engagement

  • Platform health (freshness, utilization)

  • Partner with data and ops teams to ensure content performance dashboards are available and actionable for live-ops decisions.

  • Implement content and placement optimizations based on performance insights and marketing strategy.

  • Support experimentation efforts (e.g. placement testing, A/B tests where feasible).

    • Scaling & Enablement

  • Support x.la’s evolution into a scalable ecosystem of partner, brand, influencer, and creator storefront pages.

  • Help define templates, repeatable processes, and operating standards to support scale.

  • Normalize processes across x.la and Xsolla Mall where possible, adapting where necessary.

  • Provide structured feedback to ops and product teams on tooling gaps and improvement opportunities.

  • Build up a Content Calendar process to lay out a roadmap for content development

• 2–5 years of experience in content operations, digital merchandising, marketplace operations, or similar roles.

  • Experience managing homepage or platform content, content calendars, or live digital surfaces.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools and agentic AI workflows (LLMs, AI agents, automation platforms) to content operations — not just familiarity, but practical integration into day-to-day work.

  • Ability to identify repetitive operational processes and design AI-driven automations (including autonomous or semi-autonomous agents) to improve speed, consistency, and scale.

  • Comfort working with evolving AI tooling; willingness to experiment with and iterate on AI agents and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple stakeholders and priorities.

  • Comfortable working in evolving systems and building processes where tools are still maturing.

  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to guide decisions.

  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, project tracking tools, and dashboards.

    • Nice to Have (AI Automation Skills)

  • Experience building agentic workflows using tools such as Claude, n8n, or similar platforms.

  • Familiarity with connecting AI tools to operational systems (CMS, project management, communication platforms) for end-to-end automation.

  • Track record of reducing manual operational overhead through AI-assisted processes.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Customer Success Manager at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok. You will work side by side with our HQ and APAC Customer Success Managers, supporting the day-to-day success of the Traffic Source Partners we onboard — affiliates, media partners, creator networks, and publishers who drive players to the web shops we operate for game developers.
The centre of gravity of this role is account management operations, and in particular partner payouts:making sure every partner is set up correctly, that their performance data is accurate, that their payout is calculated, documented, approved and paid on time, and that any discrepancy is chased down and closed. It is detailed work that partners feel immediately — getting it right is how trust in the programme gets built.
This is an entry-level position with real ownership from day one. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply, provided you have the right attitude and eagerness to learn. If you are organised, comfortable with numbers, enjoy being the reliable person other teams can count on, and want to learn the commercial side of the games industry from the inside, we would love to hear from you.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Partner payouts & account operations (primary)
Own the recurring payout cycle for onboarded Traffic Source Partners: collect and validate performance data, prepare payout calculations against agreed commercial terms (revenue share, CPA, fixed fee, bonuses), and submit them for approval.
Work with Finance, Legal, and Partnerships to make sure each partner's invoicing, tax, and banking documentation is complete and current before payment.
Investigate and resolve payout discrepancies — missing conversions, mismatched reporting periods, currency and FX questions, adjustments and clawbacks — and communicate the outcome clearly to the partner.
Maintain accurate partner records: contacts, contract terms, payout schedules, tracking setup, and account status in CRM (Salesforce) and internal trackers.
Produce recurring reporting: weekly partner status, monthly payout reconciliation, and inputs for quarterly business reviews.
Customer success support
Support the HQ and APAC CSM team on standard customer success duties across the partner portfolio — meeting preparation, follow-ups, action-item tracking, and documentation.
Help onboard new Traffic Source Partners: account setup, documentation, tracking-link setup, first campaign, and first payout.
Act as first-line responder for partner questions, escalating technical issues to Engineering and commercial questions to the account owner.
Monitor partner performance dashboards and proactively flag anomalies — traffic drops, conversion drops, stalled integrations, unpaid balances — before they become escalations.
Act as the voice of the partner internally, liaising with Product, Engineering, Design, BD, and Support so requests are delivered accurately and on time.
Ways of working
Coordinate across time zones with HQ, APAC Partnerships, and regional teams.
Keep process documentation, decision logs, and onboarding notes current in Confluence; track work in Jira.
Spot the repetitive parts of the payout and reporting process and propose ways to simplify or automate them.
REQUIREMENTS
1–4 years of experience in customer success, account management, partner or affiliate operations, ad operations, finance operations, or a comparable client-facing or operational role. Fresh graduates with the right attitude are welcome.
Fluent in English; you will work in English daily with HQ and APAC colleagues and partners.
Strong numeracy and confident spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel: lookups, pivot tables, reconciliation).
Exceptional attention to detail. This role touches money movement; accuracy matters more than speed.
Highly organised and self-directed — able to run a recurring process on a calendar without being chased.
Clear written communicator, able to explain a payout calculation or a tracking issue in plain language to a partner or a teammate.
Comfortable working across APAC and HQ time zones and in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift.
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Vladivostok for an onsite role.
NICE TO HAVE
Exposure to affiliate marketing, performance marketing, ad networks, or creator and influencer programmes.
Familiarity with CRM tooling (Salesforce), Jira and Confluence, or BI dashboards.
Basic understanding of invoicing, VAT or withholding tax, and cross-border payment flows.
Interest in the gaming industry, payments and fintech, or B2B SaaS.
Additional languages relevant to APAC coverage (Korean, Chinese, Japanese).
Any prior experience in coordination, support, operations, or student project lead roles.
BENEFITS
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

• 1. Architecture & Development
  • Design, build, and optimize data pipelines and ETL workflows in Snowflake using Snowpark, Streams/Tasks, and Snowpipe.
  • Develop scalable data models, Algorithm supporting user 360 views, churn prediction, and recommendation engine inputs.
  • Lead integration across data sources: MySQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, GCP Storage, and API Gateway.
  • Implement CI/CD for data pipelines using Git, dbt, and automated testing.
  • Define data quality checks and auditing pipelines for ingestion and transformation layers.
  • 2. Leadership & Collaboration
  • Mentor and guide junior data engineers on data modeling, performance tuning, and Snowflake best practices.
  • Partner with Data Science, ML, and Backend teams to productionize machine learning features in Snowflake.
  • Work closely with Legal, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure compliance, privacy, and governance of user data (PII).
  • Collaborate with the Director of Data Platforms and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • 3. Performance & Scalability
  • Tune algorithm performance.
  • Establish data partitioning, clustering, and materialized views for fast query execution.
  • Build dashboards and monitors for pipeline health, job success, and data latency metrics (e.g., via Looker, Tableau, or Snowsight).
  • 4. Governance & Best Practices
  • Establish and enforce naming conventions, data lineage, and metadata standards across schemas.
  • Lead code reviews, enforce documentation standards, and manage schema versioning.
  • Contribute to the company’s evolving data mesh and streaming architecture vision.

• 5+ years of experience in Data Scientist, with 3+ years in Spark framework.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with proven experience building ETL/ELT at scale.
  • Deep understanding of algorithm performance tuning, query optimization, and warehouse orchestration.
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, dbt, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (Kimball, Data Vault, or hybrid).
  • Proficiency in Kafka, GCP, or AWS for real-time or batch ingestion.
  • Familiarity with API-based data integration and microservice architectures.
  • Preferred
  • Experience lead machine learning teams or/and deploying ML feature pipelines.
  • Background in ad-tech, gaming, or e-commerce recommendation systems.
  • Familiarity with data contracts and feature stores (Feast, Tecton, or custom-built).
  • Experience managing small data engineering teams and setting technical direction
  • Strong ownership and ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication — can translate between engineering and business.
  • Hands-on problem solver who balances velocity with reliability.
  • Collaborative mentor who raises the bar for team quality and discipline

lists.content:
Strategic Account Ownership
 
  • Own a portfolio of strategic advertiser and demand-side accounts running high-value user acquisition campaigns on the Xsolla Offerwall, serving as the senior point of contact for both day-to-day management and long-term strategic growth.
  • Drive revenue growth by identifying and closing upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts, and by leading the onboarding of new, high-priority demand partners aligned with Xsolla's publisher network.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to UA and monetization leadership at partner studios, providing senior-level guidance on budget allocation, creative strategy, targeting, and bid optimization within the Offerwall environment.
    •  
    Problem Solving & Diagnostics
  • Serve as the escalation point for the most complex, ambiguous account issues — performance anomalies with no obvious cause, cross-functional breakdowns, or conflicts between partner expectations and platform capabilities — and drive them to resolution.
  • Approach every issue methodically: isolate variables, form and test hypotheses against the data, and distinguish root causes from surface-level symptoms before recommending a fix.
  • Monitor campaign performance closely, using KPIs such as CPI, CTR, ROAS, ARPDAU, and LTV to diagnose issues, surface insights, and recommend optimizations that improve outcomes for advertisers.
  • Anticipate risk before it materializes — using pattern recognition from past account issues to flag potential problems proactively and build safeguards into partner strategies.
  • Coach and support other account managers in developing a structured, diagnostic approach to partner problems, raising the problem-solving bar across the team
    •  
    Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
     
  • Develop and present data-driven business reviews, campaign recaps, and growth roadmaps that translate performance metrics and problem resolutions into clear, executive-ready strategies for partners.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Xsolla's product, operations, and technical teams to relay partner feedback, resolve campaign blockers, and directly influence the product roadmap based on patterns observed across your account portfolio.
  • Stay current on trends in mobile user acquisition, rewarded advertising, and the broader AdTech landscape, and translate those trends into forward-looking recommendations for partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple high-value accounts and competing priorities simultaneously, consistently delivering results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Experience
  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or business development within AdTech, mobile advertising, user acquisition, or a related performance marketing field, with a track record of managing strategic or high-value accounts.
  • Demonstrated history of growing advertiser accounts, exceeding revenue targets, and managing complex client relationships end-to-end, including through periods of ambiguity or account distress.

    • Problem-Solving Mindset
  • A structured, hypothesis-driven approach to ambiguity — able to break down a messy, undefined problem into testable pieces rather than waiting for someone else to define the issue.
  • Proven track record of resolving complex, cross-functional issues independently, with sound judgment on when to dig in personally versus when to mobilize the right internal stakeholders.
  • Genuine curiosity about "why" — treats every escalation or performance dip as a question to be answered with data, not just a ticket to be closed.
  • Resilience and resourcefulness when the first solution doesn't work; iterates quickly and knows how to course-correct without losing partner confidence.
  • Comfortable being the person others turn to when a problem doesn't have a clear owner or an obvious answer.
    •  
    Analytical Strength
  • Comfortable working with performance data and KPIs including CPI, CPM, CPC, CTR, ROAS, ARPDAU, and LTV, using them not just to report performance but to drive root-cause diagnosis. 
  • Able to diagnose campaign performance issues, interpret trends, and translate data into concrete, strategic recommendations for partners.
  • Proficient in tools such as Google Sheets, BI dashboards, and CRM platforms.
    •  
    Industry Knowledge
     
  • Deep understanding of mobile user acquisition strategies, rewarded advertising mechanics, and performance marketing models.
  • Strong familiarity with the gaming publisher and advertiser ecosystem, including how game studios approach UA spend, retention, and LTV optimization.
  • Experience with offerwalls or rewarded ad networks strongly preferred.
    •  
    Communication & Collaboration
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills; able to communicate campaign performance, strategic recommendations, and problem resolutions clearly to both technical and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with product, operations, and technical teams to deliver for clients and drive issues to closure.
  • Skilled at building trust with partners and maintaining long-term relationships grounded in accountability, transparency, and results — especially when the news isn't good.
    •  
    Mindset
  • Proactive, entrepreneurial, and commercially oriented — takes full ownership of outcomes and thrives with minimal oversight.
  • Views obstacles as puzzles to be solved rather than blockers to be escalated.
  • Comfortable managing multiple high-stakes accounts and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Curious and growth-focused, with a genuine interest in the intersection of gaming and performance advertising, and a desire to mentor others.

This is an exciting opportunity to own the advertiser side of a premium rewarded inventory network at the intersection of mobile gaming, user acquisition, and advertising technology. The best candidate is someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment and is passionate about helping game studios achieve their acquisition goals through performance-driven advertising.
In this client-facing role, you'll build and grow relationships with gaming studios and UA teams, optimizing campaign performance and ensuring partners get measurable results through Xsolla's Offerwall. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to advertisers, translating data into actionable strategies, and collaborate closely with Xsolla's product, operations, and technical teams to continuously improve the partner experience.
Strong account management skills, a deep familiarity with mobile gaming and performance advertising, and the ability to balance day-to-day campaign management with long-term partner growth will be key to your success. If you're energized by the intersection of gaming and performance marketing and love building meaningful advertiser relationships, we'd love to hear from you!

• Establish and maintain a strong presence in top game developer communities .
  • Represent Xsolla at developer conferences, meetups, and industry events .
  • Organize and participate in developer meetups, hackathons, and regional gatherings.

  • Solid understanding of game development processes and tools (mobile, PC, and/or web).
  • Proven ability to produce engaging technical content across multiple formats.
  • Strong presence in online developer communities and comfort in public speaking.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to travel for conferences, meetups, and other community events.

We are looking for a Developer Evangelist – Integrations to be a hands-on technical advocate who empowers game developers to successfully integrate Xsolla’s products and features into their games. This role blends deep technical expertise, solution-building skills, and community presence to help developers create smooth, scalable, and high-quality implementations.
 
You will work directly with partners, lead technical workshops, create integration-focused resources, and contribute to lighthouse cases—benchmark integrations that inspire both the industry and internal teams.
 
ABOUT US
 
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

lists.content:
• Lead hands-on developer sessions, integration walkthroughs, and partner workshops.
  • Provide technical guidance for both custom integration scenarios and self-service implementations.
  • Support partners in solving integration challenges quickly and effectively, acting as a trusted technical advisor.
  • Develop high-quality technical resources, including: Integration guides, step-by-step tutorials, and sample code. Demo projects, reference implementations, and API usage examples. Recorded video walk throughs, technical webinars, and training sessions.
  • Keep all resources up to date with the latest product features and integration best practices.
  • Work with Product and Developer Relations leadership to deliver lighthouse integration cases—top-tier implementations that showcase the full potential of Xsolla’s solutions.
  • Document and package these integrations as reusable templates and inspiration for other developers.
  • Represent Xsolla at industry events, technical conferences, and meetups.
  • Conduct technical presentations, live demos, and coding sessions that inspire confidence in Xsolla’s integration capabilities.
  • Collect and relay developer feedback on integration processes and tools to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Recommend improvements to SDKs, APIs, and documentation to streamline integration efforts.
  • Track and report on: Number and quality of integrations delivered or supported. Engagement with integration-focused resources. Conversion rates from technical enablement to live integrations.

• 3–5 years in Developer Advocacy, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Evangelism, ideally in the game industry.
  • Strong technical skills in game development and integration (e.g., Unity, Unreal, backend APIs, payment systems).
  • Experience delivering hands-on technical training, demos, and workshops.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and customer-focused mindset.
  • Comfort in public speaking and presenting technical content to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to travel for partner visits, conferences, and training events.

lists.content:
• Lead event strategy, logistics, and on-site execution for developer-facing events, including conferences, meetups, hackathons, and activations tied to major platform launches (e.g. Apple WWDC, Google I/O).

  • Partner closely with Developer Relations to translate regional developer engagement priorities into event plans, ensuring evangelists and technical staff have what they need to shine on-site.

  • Manage sponsorship deliverables and partnerships at developer- and industry-focused events.

  • Source and negotiate with venues and vendors (booth builders, AV, creative production, hotels, etc.) for developer events and activations.

  • Maintain and track detailed budgets across multiple currencies and regions for the developer events portfolio.

  • Collaborate with Developer Marketing and internal marketing teams to develop event-related campaigns, including landing pages, email marketing, and social media initiatives.

  • Create and manage event listings on the Xsolla website and registration platforms (e.g., Splash, Luma).

  • Partner with creative teams to brief and deliver event materials, graphics, and branded assets tailored to developer audiences.

  • Coordinate speaking sessions, workshops, and panel participation with Developer Relations, Product, and internal stakeholders.

  • Support the on-site delivery of lighthouse integration showcases and technical demos, working with Developer Relations to bring their content to life at events.

  • Own event product demonstrations end-to-end — ensuring product demos are ready for each event, and that the Xsolla team attending is fully trained with the correct guidance materials, in partnership with each Product Marketing Manager.

  • Develop pre-event briefings, on-site run-of-show documents, and post-event reports for developer-focused activations.

  • Track leads, engagement analytics, and ROI for each event, ensuring timely processing within CRM systems.

  • Support new event research, sponsorship evaluations, and strategic recommendations for future developer-focused activations.

  • Travel internationally as needed to oversee event delivery and represent Xsolla at global developer and industry gatherings.

• 3+ years of experience in event management or experiential marketing, ideally within the gaming, tech, or software industry.

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in developer relations, developer advocacy, or technical communities — you don't need to write code, but you understand what makes developers tick.

  • Proven ability to manage global events and understand regional nuances and budgets.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills - able to handle multiple simultaneous projects with precision.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (written and verbal), comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Creative problem-solver with the ability to make quick, informed decisions.

  • High attention to detail, quality, and brand alignment.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace; experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) is a plus.

  • Familiarity with event registration and marketing platforms such as Splash and Luma.

  • Ability to travel internationally and work flexible hours to support global time zones.

• Implement the global Developer Marketing strategy in your assigned region, tailoring campaigns to local developer audiences and market trends.
  • Manage and execute regional developer marketing initiatives, including event participation, online campaigns, and community programs.
  • Partner with regional Developer Evangelists to promote lighthouse integration cases and success stories.

  • Organize and promote regional hackathons, meetups, and community gatherings.

  • Collaborate with Developer Evangelists and the marketing team to produce articles, videos, social content, and newsletters.
  • Promote educational materials and integration showcases through relevant regional channels.
  • Extend Xsolla’s presence into key regional game developer communities (online and offline), supporting community programs and partnerships.

  • Use insights to adjust tactics and optimize future campaigns.

• 3–5years of marketing experience, ideally in developer relations, B2B tech marketing, or gaming industry marketing.
  • Strong understanding of local game development ecosystems and communities.
  • Proven ability to run multi-channel campaigns and event marketing programs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional and global teams.
  • Comfort in working closely with technical content and understanding developer needs.
  • Willingness to travel for regional events and community activities.

lists.content:
• Oversee all developer relations activities in your assigned region, ensuring alignment with global strategy and local market needs.
  • Manage and mentor Developer Evangelists (Community & Integrations), fostering a culture of technical excellence and developer empathy.
  • Lead the delivery of lighthouse integration cases—high-quality, benchmark implementations that inspire both partners and internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to capture and act on developer feedback, removing adoption barriers and improving satisfaction.
  • Act as a senior advocate for game developers in your region, building trust and maintaining a visible presence in both online and offline communities.
  • Represent Xsolla at major regional and global industry events, delivering high-impact presentations and workshops.
  • Organize and support developer meetups, hackathons, and targeted events around major platform launches (Apple WWDC, Google I/O).
  • Guide the creation of best-in-class developer documentation, tutorials, demos, videos, and other educational materials tailored to your region’s market.
  • Ensure content addresses both custom integration scenarios and self-service use cases to maximize reach and adoption.
  • Collaborate with Developer Marketing to promote materials and track impact across all channels.
  • Regularly review performance with the VP of Developer Relations, making data-driven adjustments to tactics and priorities.

• 5+ years in Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, or Technical Evangelism, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong technical background in game development (mobile, PC, or web), including hands-on experience with integrations and APIs.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed teams and deliver measurable engagement outcomes.
  • Established presence in regional and global game developer communities.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, comfortable speaking to both technical and business audiences.
  • Experience producing high-quality technical content in multiple formats.

主な職務内容

1. Digital Marketing Strategy

−日本市場におけるデジタルマーケティング戦略の策定・実行

−Global / APACのマーケティング戦略を日本市場向けにローカライズ

−ブランド認知、Lead Generation、Engagement、Pipeline Creationにつながるデジタル施策の企画

2. Website & SEO

−日本向けWebサイトおよびLanding Pageの企画・運用・改善

−SEO戦略の策定と実行、SEOキーワードの調査・分析

−Global Webチーム、Designチームなどとの連携

3. Content Marketing

−日本市場向けのBlog、ホワイトペーパー、ケーススタディ、AIツールを使ったスライド動画などの企画・制作

−Globalコンテンツの日本市場向けローカライズ、翻訳等

−SEOを意識したコンテンツ戦略の策定

−コンテンツパフォーマンスの分析と改善

−日本のゲーム業界・顧客ニーズに合わせたコンテンツテーマの企画

4. Digital Campaign & Lead Generation

−デジタル広告キャンペーンの企画・実行（本社とのやりとり）

−Campaign Landing Page、Email、広告などを組み合わせたIntegrated Campaignの実施

5. CRM & Marketing Automation

−Email MarketingおよびNewsletterの企画・運用

−Marketing Automationツールを活用したLead Nurturing（Hubspot)

−顧客・Prospectのセグメンテーション

−Campaign MemberやLeadデータの管理・改善

 

6. Data & Performance Analytics

−定期的なMarketing Performance Reportの作成

−Google Analytics、Looker Studio、CRMなどを活用したマーケティングデータ分析（あれば尚可）

7. Cross-functional Collaboration

−イベント前後のDigital Campaign

−Global Marketing / APAC Marketingとのベストプラクティス共有

−Designチームや他チームとのプロジェクト連携

応募資格

−3〜5年以上のDigital Marketing経験

−B2B Marketingでの経験があることが望ましい

−Website、SEO、Content Marketing、Digital Advertising、Email Marketingなどの翻訳のみではなく自らコンテンツ作成を担当した経験

-Digital Campaignを企画から実行まで一貫して担当した経験

 

〜以下のスキルがあれば尚可〜

CRM / Marketing Automationツール（Salesforce、Hubspot等）の基本的な理解

SEOおよびContent Marketingに関する実務知識

オーガニック流入、コンバージョン率などの分析・改善

Webサイト上のユーザージャーニーやコンバージョン導線の改善

データに基づいた施策改善および意思決定のサポート

Google Analytics、CRMなどを活用したマーケティングデータ分析

Website Traffic、Conversion、MQL、PipelineなどのKPI管理

 

言語

日本語：ネイティブレベル

英語：ビジネスレベル以上

 

求める人物像

変化の速い環境でも柔軟性があり、変化を前向きに楽しめる方

異なるチームと協力して仕事を進められる方、フィードバックを前向きに受け入れられる方

数字とクリエイティブの両方に興味がある方

「言われたことを実行する」だけではなく、自ら課題を発見して実行できる方

新しいDigital Marketing ToolsやAI Toolsを積極的に学べる方

lists.content:
• Lead and grow a high-performing, distributed team of data scientists, ML engineers, and data platform engineers.
  • Define and execute the data science and ad tech roadmap, advancing initiatives in user modeling, campaign optimization, targeting, and personalization.
  • Architect and manage ML pipelines and experimentation frameworks, including feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, A/B testing, and causal inference systems.
  • Oversee real-time pipelines for ad events (e.g., impressions, clicks, conversions), enabling responsive attribution and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with Product, Growth, and Marketing to develop audience scoring, LTV/churn models, and incrementality testing for media measurement and bidding efficiency.
  • Ensure scalable, privacy-compliant data infrastructure aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and ATT, including support for SKAdNetwork, CMPs, and identity frameworks.
  • Foster engineering excellence with a focus on reproducibility, model evaluation, observability, and model lifecycle management.
  • Drive a strong feedback loop between experimentation and business outcomes, translating data science insights into product and go-to-market wins.
  • Mentor engineers and scientists on career development, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership.

• 5+ years of experience in software/data engineering or applied data science, with 3+ years managing technical teams in ML, analytics, or ad tech domains.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling, including regression, classification, causal inference, uplift modeling, and forecasting.
  • Hands-on experience with ML/data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark, Airflow, dbt, MLFlow, and feature stores.
  • Proven experience in architecting and deploying end-to-end ML systems into production (batch and real-time).
  • Knowledge of ad tech ecosystems, including campaign hierarchies, attribution models (multi-touch, view-through), and creative performance tracking.
  • Familiarity with audience management, segmentation, and personalization frameworks in programmatic or CRM marketing.
  • Experience with privacy-preserving measurement, including support for SKAdNetwork, GAID/IDFA deprecation, and consent systems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. PhD is a plus.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT US  

Xsolla is a global video game commerce company that provides a comprehensive suite of tools and services for game developers and publishers - including payments, distribution, game stores, launcher solutions, and partner network services. Our platform processes transactions across 200+ geographies, supporting thousands of games and millions of players worldwide. Quality is not optional - it is foundational to every product we ship.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director of QA is a senior technical leadership role responsible for owning and scaling Xsolla's quality engineering function across multiple product lines, teams, and time zones. You will define and drive the strategic vision for quality assurance - from test automation architecture and CI/CD integration to AI-assisted testing practices and performance engineering. You will lead a distributed organization of 30+ QA engineers and leads as part of a broader QA organization of 75+ professionals, ensuring predictable, high-quality releases across every product Xsolla delivers. This is not a management-only position. You must be deeply technical - capable of reviewing automation code, architecting test frameworks, debugging CI/CD pipelines, and evaluating AI-driven testing approaches hands-on.
