• Client-Facing & Pre-Sales

    • Lead and confidently run client meetings, calls, and technical demos independently, without needing a BD or CS lead to carry the conversation

    • Act as the primary technical point of contact during pre-sales and onboarding, scoping integration requirements and setting realistic expectations

    • Present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders (engineers, producers, executives)

      • Technical Integration & Troubleshooting

      • Guide partners through API integration, including authentication, request/response structures, JSON payloads, and webhook configuration and delivery

      • Diagnose issues using data dumps, technical logs, and API traces; distinguish integration errors from platform bugs

      • Write and interpret basic scripts or API calls (e.g., via Postman, curl) to reproduce and isolate client-reported issues

      • Document issues concisely and completely enough for engineering to act on without back-and-forth

      • Know when to resolve an issue directly versus escalate to Engineering, Product, or Support, and manage that handoff cleanly

        • Cross-Functional Communication

        • Serve as the communication hub between Client, Business Development, Customer Success, and Development teams, ensuring nothing gets lost in translation between technical and commercial priorities

        • Provide clear, well-organized status updates to internal stakeholders and clients throughout the integration lifecycle

        • Maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, and related tools

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a related field

  • 3+ years of experience in technical integration, solutions engineering, or a client-facing technical role

  • Demonstrated ability to lead client meetings and presentations independently — this is not a support-only or backend role

  • Comfortable using tools like Postman (or equivalent) to test and debug API calls

  • Near-native fluency in both Japanese and English, written and verbal; able to confidently lead client presentations and meetings and write professional business emails in either language without support (daily cross-team communication is in English)

  • Strong attention to detail and time management

• Prior experience in the gaming industry, payments, or fintech

  • Experience with Confluence, Jira, and G Suite

  • Prior experience at a foreign or international company, or working across time zones with global teams

Procurement and vendor coordination
  • Raise and track purchase orders for laptops, peripherals, networking gear and accessories with approved local and international vendors.
  • Compare quotes, confirm delivery dates and escalate delays or pricing issues.
  • Maintain vendor contacts, warranty terms and return/RMA processes.
    • Inbound shipping and customs
  • Coordinate international shipments with freight forwarders and couriers.
  • Track shipments end to end and report expected arrival dates to IT and requesters.
  • Log deliveries against the order; report damage or shortages within the vendor's claim window.
    • Inventory and asset management
  • Keep the asset register accurate: serial numbers, assignee, location, status and warranty dates.
  • Run regular stock counts and reconcile them with the register; investigate discrepancies.
  • Maintain safe, organized storage for hardware, with minimum stock levels for common items.
    • Deployment and lifecycle logistics
  • Manage handover and return of equipment for joiners, leavers and role changes.
  • Coordinate secure disposal, recycling or donation of retired equipment, including data-wiping confirmation from IT.
    • Reporting and process improvement
  • Report monthly on stock levels, open orders, delivery times and logistics costs.
  • Participate in improvements projects that reduce lead times, cost or loss.

Required
  • 2+ years in IT logistics, supply chain, procurement or IT asset management.
  • Working knowledge of import procedures and customs documentation.
  • Experience maintaining an inventory or asset register (spreadsheet, ITAM or ERP tool).
  • Professional English, written and spoken.
    • Preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain, IT, business or a related field.
  • Familiarity with IT hardware (laptops, mobile devices, networking equipment) and common vendor ecosystems.
  • Experience with an ITSM or ticketing system such as Jira Service Management.
  • Working Russian.
  • Certification such as ITIL Foundation, CSCP or CPIM.
    • Skills and competencies
  • Organization: keeps many open orders and shipments straight and prioritizes by urgency.
  • Attention to detail: records serial numbers, quantities and dates accurately every time.
  • Vendor management: negotiates delivery terms and follows up until issues are closed.
  • Communication: gives requesters clear status updates and writes concise reports.
  • Problem solving: resolves customs holds, damaged goods and stock shortages without waiting to be told.
  • Integrity: handles high-value equipment and asset records with care and honesty.
  • Tools: strong Excel or Google Sheets; comfortable learning ITAM, ERP and ticketing systems

lists.content:
• Triage Security Findings - Assess incoming bug bounty reports and scanner findings. Evaluate validity, calculate real severity, and escalate appropriately with clear written summaries.

  • Assist with Vulnerability Assessments - Participate in security assessments of web applications and APIs. Help identify and document risks in new features and existing systems.

  • Write Clear Security Documentation - Document findings, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance in a way that engineering teams can act on.

  • Support Threat Modeling - Participate in threat modeling sessions. Learn to identify trust boundaries, data flows, and attack surfaces in system designs.

  • Monitor Security Tools - Help operate SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning tooling. Track findings, reduce noise, and support remediation workflows.

  • Support Code Reviews - Review code for common vulnerability classes under guidance of senior specialists. Learn to identify security issues across PHP, Python, and Go codebases.

  • Stay Current - Follow developments in the security community. Bring awareness of new vulnerability classes, CVEs, and attack techniques relevant to our stack.

• Web Security Fundamentals - Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes: OWASP Top 10, CSRF, XSS, IDOR, SQL injection, open redirect, authentication and session management weaknesses. You understand root causes, not just names.

  • Web and Browser Fundamentals - Solid understanding of how web applications work: HTTP request/response cycle, client-server model, REST APIs, how browsers handle same-origin policy, cookies and their attributes, and CORS. This is the foundation everything else builds on.

  • Security Testing Tools - Hands-on experience with Burp Suite or similar web application security testing tools. You have used them to intercept, modify, and replay requests — not just run automated scans.

  • Vulnerability Documentation - Able to reproduce a vulnerability and write it up clearly: reproduction steps, proof of concept, and impact statement. Findings that engineering teams cannot reproduce or understand do not get fixed.

  • Secure Development Awareness - Familiarity with foundational secure coding concepts: input validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and least privilege.

  • Code Readability - Ability to read and follow code in at least one language relevant to web security - PHP, Python, JavaScript, or Go. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to follow logic and spot security-relevant patterns.

  • Analytical Thinking - You reason through problems methodically. You can explain not just what a vulnerability is but why it exists, how it is exploited, and what fixing it actually requires.

  • Clear Written Communication - You write findings and summaries that are precise, reproducible, and useful to the engineers who need to act on them.

  • Curiosity and Initiative - You dig into problems rather than stopping at the surface. When something looks wrong, you investigate before concluding

• Participation in bug bounty programs or CTF competitions;

  • Basic scripting ability for automation - Python or Bash;

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and where security tooling fits;

  • Exposure to cloud environments - GCP, AWS, or Azure;

  • Relevant coursework or certifications - eWPT, CEH, PortSwigger Web Security Academy progress, or similar entry-level credentials.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Junior Developer (AI Engineering) to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) team, a platform that connects game studios and publishers with content creators. The position involves participation in all stages of work on an automated content generation system: from stabilising the existing vertical video pipeline for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels to developing the agentic architecture, launching the virtual AI creator direction and building analytics on the results. Working with the team means applying cutting-edge generative models and agentic tools to a real production product every day, seeing the direct effect of your work in content metrics, and learning from the inside how the games industry, the creator economy and content-driven game promotion work. The developer will work with a live system that has a real audience and measurable results, make technical decisions independently, build expertise in generative AI and take on the role of the project's technical owner as it grows.

lists.content:
• Take over the existing vertical video generation pipeline (script → voiceover → visuals → subtitles → editing → auto-posting → tracking links) for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels, understand it from the docs and code, and bring it to stable operation.
  • Grow the pipeline: improve content quality and virality, scale up generation volume, reduce cost and turnaround time per video.
  • Keep track of new generation models and services (video, image, voice, LLM), test them quickly and replace outdated parts of the pipeline with better or cheaper ones.
  • Launch and develop the virtual AI creator direction: a consistent character, voice, style and content plan.
  • Design and improve agents: write and debug prompts and sub-agent roles, validation between phases, context and cost control.
  • Build a dashboard for running generation and tracking content analytics (views, clicks, conversions, cost per video).
  • Automate publishing: platform integrations, posting from mobile devices, scaling channels.
  • Write clean, testable, documented code, including unit and integration tests.

• Solid Python, basic bash.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) and agentic pipelines: a real project, pet project or hackathon entry you can show and talk through.
  • Experience using Claude Code, Cursor or similar tools as a working environment, not just as autocomplete.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering basics: defining an agent's role, limiting context, getting stable structured output.
  • Understanding of Git, team development and Docker basics.
  • Ability to work with REST APIs and webhooks, basic understanding of databases (SQL).
  • Understanding of vertical content: games, creators, streams, TikToks, Shorts, how video discovery works, what shadowbans are, how mobile posting farms are set up. A big plus if this is your hobby: your own channel, editing, streaming, experiments with AI generation.
  • Ownership: the ability to take a task end to end and deliver a result without external supervision.
  • Initiative: your own proposals on improving the pipeline, new models and automation, and the readiness to implement them yourself.
  • Ability to figure out someone else's system from code and documentation, reconstruct the logic and ask the right questions.
  • Independence in technical decisions and openness in communication: flag problems immediately.
  • Product thinking: measuring results by content metrics (views, retention, clicks) and cost per video.
  • Ability to explain the system's capabilities and limitations to non-technical colleagues.
  • Experimental mindset: fast hypothesis testing and the willingness to drop what did not work.
  • Desire to grow with the project: from stabilising the current pipeline to becoming its technical owner.
  • English at the level of reading technical documentation (Intermediate+).

• Experience with video and image generation via API (fal.ai, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Nano Banana, etc.), TTS and speech recognition (Whisper and similar).
  • ffmpeg: assembly, normalisation, subtitles, overlays.
  • Experience building reliable calls to paid APIs: retries, idempotency, cost tracking.
  • n8n or other workflow tools.
  • Telegram bots, YouTube / TikTok / Instagram / Discord APIs.
  • Android / mobile device automation.
  • Supabase or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with GCP, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Observability and monitoring (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
  • Your own channel, pet projects, open-source experience or hackathon participation.

We are looking for a Junior Developer (AI Engineering) to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) team, a platform that connects game studios and publishers with content creators. The position involves participation in all stages of work on an automated content generation system: from stabilising the existing vertical video pipeline for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels to developing the agentic architecture, launching the virtual AI creator direction and building analytics on the results. lists.content:
• Support and help execute day-to-day user acquisition campaigns across key paid channels (Meta, Google/YouTube, LinkedIn, Mobile DSP's) in alignment with product goals and growth targets.

  • Plan, launch, and optimize performance campaigns across B2B and B2C objectives, driving measurable outcomes like leads, installs, registrations, purchases, and ROAS.

  • Contribute to a structured testing roadmap across targeting, creative concepts, bidding strategies, and landing flows, helping prioritize tests and document results.

  • Monitor campaign performance regularly; flag performance shifts and surface optimization recommendations (budget pacing, creative rotation, audience adjustments, bid changes) to senior team members.

  • Work closely with Art and Design teams to help brief and iterate on ad creatives, tying feedback to performance data and campaign learnings.

  • Collaborate with Product and Analytics stakeholders to support accurate tracking setup (UTMs, pixels, SDK events, attribution tools) and ensure campaigns are measurable end-to-end.

  • Contribute to recurring performance reports (weekly/monthly) with clear summaries of what's working, what isn't, and suggested next steps, with support from senior teammates as needed.

  • Assist with budget tracking and spend pacing across campaigns, flagging discrepancies and helping ensure performance stays on target.

  • Keep campaign documentation, learnings, and best practices organized and up to date to support team efficiency and institutional knowledge.

  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to help ensure campaigns align with product launches, promotions, and key seasonal moments.

• 2+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Paid Media, or Growth Marketing with hands-on exposure across B2B and/or B2C campaigns; some familiarity with mobile UA is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience managing campaigns across one or more major advertising platforms  (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads/YouTube, or LinkedIn Ads) with growing comfort across multiple channels.

  • Working knowledge of performance metrics across B2B (CPL, MQL, pipeline contribution, CAC) and B2C (CPA, ROAS, LTV, conversion rates) contexts, with the ability to use data to flag trends and suggest optimizations.

  • Comfortable in Excel/Google Sheets for reporting and performance tracking; able to work with dashboards and communicate findings clearly to your immediate team.

  • A collaborative team player who can work cross-functionally with creative, sales, and product teams, communicating clearly and following through on shared priorities.

  • Organized and reasonably self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and tasks with some guidance.

• Some hands-on exposure to mobile UA platforms (e.g., Meta App Campaigns, Apple Search Ads, Google UAC) and/or attribution tools (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust).

  • Some experience with A/B testing, landing page optimization, or funnel analysis, even if early-stage or limited in scope.

  • A developing understanding of audience segmentation and how targeting strategies differ between B2B and B2C campaigns.

  • Comfort with GA4 or similar web analytics tools and an ability to connect paid performance to basic on-site metrics.

  • Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, Confluence or Notion is a bonus.

• Lead the creation of high-quality environments from concept through final implementation.
  • Establish and maintain the visual quality bar for environments while ensuring technical and performance requirements are met.
  • Create optimized environment assets, including modular kits, architecture, terrain, props, materials, and set dressing.
  • Work closely with Technical Artists, Level Designers, Lighting Artists, and Engineers to balance visual quality with performance.
  • Define and maintain environment art pipelines, workflows, and technical standards.
  • Identify and resolve performance issues related to geometry, materials, textures, lighting, draw calls, memory usage, LODs, and asset complexity.
  • Review and provide feedback on the work of Environment Artists and support their professional development.
  • Collaborate with Art Direction to translate the artistic vision into scalable and technically achievable environments.
  • Participate in profiling and optimization throughout production rather than treating optimization as a final-stage task.

• Strong professional experience as a Senior or Lead Environment Artist in game development.
  • Excellent portfolio demonstrating visually compelling, production-ready environments.
  • Strong understanding of real-time optimization and the ability to make informed trade-offs between visual fidelity and performance.
  • Advanced knowledge of environment production pipelines, modular workflows, LODs, materials, shaders, texture optimization, and asset budgets.
  • Strong proficiency with industry-standard 3D tools and experience working in Unreal Engine and/or Unity.
  • Good understanding of lighting, composition, scale, color, and environmental storytelling.
  • Ability to profile environments, identify technical bottlenecks, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve them.
  • Leadership and mentoring experience, with the ability to provide clear and constructive artistic and technical feedback.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

lists.content:
• Own and lead manual testing of complex features across multiple environments
  • Drive exploratory and regression testing using structured documentation and product knowledge
  • Identify, log, and track reproducible issues with precision using bug tracking tools (e.g. Jira)
  • Analyze production logs and real-user behavior to proactively identify quality gaps
  • Create and maintain detailed test cases, checklists, and QA documentation
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure reliable CI/CD test coverage
  • Evaluate and integrate AI-powered tools (e.g. test generation, log analysis, visual regression) into QA workflows
  • Set up and manage test environments, staging pipelines, and job configurations
  • Conduct load/stress testing and performance investigations
  • Act as a quality advocate across sprint planning, reviews, and release cycles
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and promote a culture of proactive quality ownership

• Proven experience in software QA or testing roles, including ownership of end-to-end quality
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Strong understanding of manual testing methodologies and defect life cycle
  • Proficiency with bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira) and version control (e.g., Git)
  • Practical experience using Postman and similar tools for API validation
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment readiness processes
  • Proficiency with browser developer tools and basic terminal/command-line usage
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing tools (e.g., test case generation, smart test prioritization, AI log analysis)

• Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for automated test development
  • Understanding of backend technologies, APIs, and familiarity with PHP or related languages
  • Experience working in Linux environments and using Bash scripting
  • Hands-on with AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Testim, Mabl, or AI-based bug triaging tools) in a QA context

• Design, implement, and optimize technical solutions based on the needs of users in the China region, continuously improving service performance and stability.

  • Own implementation from design to deployment, ensuring maintainability and performance.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and offer informed technical input.

  • continuity.

  • discussions.

lists.content:
• NetSuite ERP Administration & Development: Serve as a primary administrator and technical owner for the NetSuite OneWorld environment, including custom records, workflows, scripts, and forms.

  • Process Optimization: Build, document, and continuously improve global financial system configurations, processes, and internal controls to drive efficiency and scalability.

  • Multi-Entity Management: Configure metadata, dimensions, security, roles, and permissions across entities. Support multi-entity, multi-currency, and multi-subsidiary operations.

  • Financial Systems Integration: Configure and maintain integrations between NetSuite OneWorld and other enterprise applications, including Salesforce, payroll systems, banking platforms, treasury applications, HRIS platforms, CRM systems, data warehouses, REST APIs, and Oracle Cloud services. Develop and monitor automated data pipelines and troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Develop and maintain reporting including Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow Reporting, Variance Analysis, Departmental Reporting, KPI Dashboards, Executive Scorecards, Global Consolidated Reporting, and Operational Metrics.

  • Data Governance: Maintain financial dimensions across reporting environments, ensure consistency and accuracy across the NetSuite ERP platform, and support master data governance initiatives. Improve data quality through validation and reconciliation processes.

  • Finance Partnership: Work closely with Finance and Accounting teams to improve financial processes, support monthly close cycles, enhance management reporting, and develop executive dashboards and reporting tools.

  • Cross-functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, and IT teams globally to ensure financial systems are integrated into business operations. Document system designs, business processes, and technical configurations, and provide training and support for business users.

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering or implementing NetSuite ERP (OneWorld).

  • Strong understanding of financial systems and accounting processes.

  • Experience supporting NetSuite OneWorld environments.

  • Understanding of multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.

  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.

  • Experience with enterprise reporting and analytics tools.

  • Proven ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and collaborate with global teams in a flexible and adaptable manner.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to present complex systems issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Knowledge of SuiteAnalytics Workbooks and SuiteQL.

  • Experience with SuiteScript or SuiteFlow for supporting integrations and automation.

  • Experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce or other enterprise applications.

  • Knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and global financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience supporting SaaS or multinational organizations.

  • NetSuite or Oracle Cloud certifications.

lists.content:
• Serve as the primary dashboard monitor during your shift — continuously watch the GTO Operational Dashboard in Datadog, detect anomalies by correlating signals across APM, logs, metrics, synthetic tests, and Real User Monitoring, and determine whether alerts warrant an incident ticket or can be resolved through immediate investigation.

  • Triage and investigate production incidents — create incident tickets in JIRA Service Management, perform initial technical investigation using Datadog (traces, logs, infrastructure and application metrics), determine blast radius and likely root cause domain, and route to the correct team (Product SRE, Infrastructure SRE, or Engineering) using the smart routing model.

  • Own lower-severity incidents end-to-end from detection through resolution — diagnose, execute runbook procedures, and resolve without escalation where possible. Escalate promptly when an incident is unresolved within defined thresholds or requires a code-level fix.

  • Support the TSO Lead during major incidents as the technical right hand in the war room — surface real-time data (error rates, impact scope, deployment history, related alerts), maintain the incident ticket with live timeline entries and linked evidence, and execute mitigation actions as directed.

  • Draft incident communications under TSO Lead direction, including internal Slack updates, stakeholder notifications, and customer-facing status page updates (status.xsolla.com). Support clear, timely communication throughout the incident lifecycle.

  • During non-incident periods, analyze incident trends, recurring issues, and production bugs — compile data from Datadog, JIRA, and Slack, identify patterns, and contribute findings to regular reports for product and engineering teams.

  • Compile incident timelines and draft initial PIR documents for Post-Incident Review preparation. Track PIR action items post-session and flag overdue items to the TSO Lead.

  • Build and maintain operational automation (alert enrichment scripts, incident templates, Slack workflows, dashboard widgets) and contribute to runbook development — documenting new resolution procedures so they can be repeated by any Operations Engineer on any shift.

  • Conduct structured shift handoffs covering active incidents, at-risk services, upcoming deployments, and follow-up items. Participate in knowledge transfer sessions with SREs to continuously expand independent resolution capability.

  • Cover for the TSO Lead during vacations, absences, or emergencies — including severity classification, escalation decisions, stakeholder communications, and basic Incident Commander functions.

  • Publish health reports of critical apps periodically.

• 4+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, production operations, NOC, or technical operations in a high-availability environment. Experience with platforms that handle payments, e-commerce, SaaS, or gaming workloads is preferred.

  • Strong troubleshooting and investigation skills — ability to take an alert or user-reported symptom and methodically trace it through the stack: application logs, APM traces, infrastructure metrics, database queries, and network paths.

  • Hands-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform: Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, Elastic) — navigating APM, building log queries, reading infrastructure dashboards, interpreting SLO burn rates, and configuring monitors and alerts.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Go, or Bash. You will write automation scripts, build operational tooling, and work with APIs.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English — ability to write incident tickets, investigation notes, Slack updates, shift handoff reports, status page communications, and PIR drafts that are clear, concise, and useful to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred, AWS/Azure acceptable) — understanding of pods, deployments, services, ingress, node health, and how to investigate Kubernetes-related production issues.

  • Understanding of SLOs, error budgets, and burn-rate alerting — knowing what a multi-window burn-rate alert means, how error budgets deplete, and how SLO breaches translate into incident severity.

  • Experience with incident management tooling: JIRA or JIRA Service Management, PagerDuty or OpsGenie, Slack, and Confluence.

  • Experience with or strong interest in AI/ML-assisted operations: anomaly detection, alert correlation, predictive monitoring, or automated remediation.

  • Comfort with 24x7 shift-based operations as part of a follow-the-sun model with handoff overlaps. Weekend on-call (rotating) is required.

• Experience in the gaming, payments, or fintech industry — particularly environments where transaction processing, checkout flows, or player-facing services must meet strict uptime requirements.

  • Familiarity with Datadog Service Catalog, synthetic monitoring, and RUM; exposure to database operations (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka); and experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Helm).

  • JIRA Service Management administration experience (workflows, automation rules, SLA timers) or ITIL Foundation certification — practical experience matters more than credentials.

lists.content:
• Serve as the primary dashboard monitor during your shift — continuously watch the GTO Operational Dashboard in Datadog, detect anomalies by correlating signals across APM, logs, metrics, synthetic tests, and Real User Monitoring, and determine whether alerts warrant an incident ticket or can be resolved through immediate investigation.

  • Triage and investigate production incidents — create incident tickets in JIRA Service Management, perform initial technical investigation using Datadog (traces, logs, infrastructure and application metrics), determine blast radius and likely root cause domain, and route to the correct team (Product SRE, Infrastructure SRE, or Engineering) using the smart routing model.

  • Own lower-severity incidents end-to-end from detection through resolution — diagnose, execute runbook procedures, and resolve without escalation where possible. Escalate promptly when an incident is unresolved within defined thresholds or requires a code-level fix.

  • Support the TSO Lead during major incidents as the technical right hand in the war room — surface real-time data (error rates, impact scope, deployment history, related alerts), maintain the incident ticket with live timeline entries and linked evidence, and execute mitigation actions as directed.

  • Draft incident communications under TSO Lead direction, including internal Slack updates, stakeholder notifications, and customer-facing status page updates (status.xsolla.com). Support clear, timely communication throughout the incident lifecycle.

  • During non-incident periods, analyze incident trends, recurring issues, and production bugs — compile data from Datadog, JIRA, and Slack, identify patterns, and contribute findings to regular reports for product and engineering teams.

  • Compile incident timelines and draft initial PIR documents for Post-Incident Review preparation. Track PIR action items post-session and flag overdue items to the TSO Lead.

  • Build and maintain operational automation (alert enrichment scripts, incident templates, Slack workflows, dashboard widgets) and contribute to runbook development — documenting new resolution procedures so they can be repeated by any Operations Engineer on any shift.

  • Conduct structured shift handoffs covering active incidents, at-risk services, upcoming deployments, and follow-up items. Participate in knowledge transfer sessions with SREs to continuously expand independent resolution capability.

  • Cover for the TSO Lead during vacations, absences, or emergencies — including severity classification, escalation decisions, stakeholder communications, and basic Incident Commander functions.

  • Publish health reports of critical apps periodically.

• Previous experience working at a gaming company is required — you understand the pace, player expectations, live operations dynamics, and the operational demands of the gaming industry.

  • 4+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, production operations, NOC, or technical operations in a high-availability environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting and investigation skills — ability to take an alert or user-reported symptom and methodically trace it through the stack: application logs, APM traces, infrastructure metrics, database queries, and network paths.

  • Hands-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform: Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, Elastic) — navigating APM, building log queries, reading infrastructure dashboards, interpreting SLO burn rates, and configuring monitors and alerts.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Go, or Bash. You will write automation scripts, build operational tooling, and work with APIs.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English — ability to write incident tickets, investigation notes, Slack updates, shift handoff reports, status page communications, and PIR drafts that are clear, concise, and useful to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred, AWS/Azure acceptable) — understanding of pods, deployments, services, ingress, node health, and how to investigate Kubernetes-related production issues.

  • Understanding of SLOs, error budgets, and burn-rate alerting — knowing what a multi-window burn-rate alert means, how error budgets deplete, and how SLO breaches translate into incident severity.

  • Experience with incident management tooling: JIRA or JIRA Service Management, PagerDuty or OpsGenie, Slack, and Confluence.

  • Experience with or strong interest in AI/ML-assisted operations: anomaly detection, alert correlation, predictive monitoring, or automated remediation.

  • Comfort with 24x7 shift-based operations as part of a follow-the-sun model with handoff overlaps. Weekend on-call (rotating) is required.

• Familiarity with Datadog Service Catalog, synthetic monitoring, and RUM (Real User Monitoring).

  • Experience with distributed systems debugging: tracing failures across microservices, understanding cascading failures, and reading distributed traces end-to-end.

  • Exposure to database operations (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka) at a level sufficient to investigate connection pool exhaustion, replication lag, slow queries, or queue backlogs during incidents.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Helm) — enough to correlate recent deployments with production issues and identify rollback targets.

  • JIRA Service Management administration experience: workflows, automation rules, SLA timers, and queues.

  • ITIL Foundation certification is a plus but not required — practical experience matters more.

ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success.
The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed.
If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Own end-to-end success of assigned partner campaigns post-signature — from kickoff through launch, live optimization, and post-campaign review.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned partners in China/APAC, building trusted, ongoing relationships rather than transactional check-ins.

  • Proactively strategize with partners on campaign structure, creator selection, storefront setup, and quest mechanics to maximize outcomes.

  • Identify risk signals early (underperformance, partner disengagement, unclear expectations) and drive corrective action before they become churn risks.

  • Coordinate directly with the XPN BD Team and Creator Success Team, pulling in the right internal resources at the right time.

  • Provide partners with clear, honest performance visibility — translating XPN data into terms that make sense for flat-fee and hybrid-model publishers.

  • Serve as an internal advocate for partner needs, feeding structured feedback back into XPN product, reporting, and process improvements.

  • Sit within the core XPN BD team and support the Core China/APAC Team in progressing late-stage opportunities — joining calls, providing local market context, and helping translate commercial terms into what will land with the partner.

  • Help identify expansion or upsell opportunities within existing successful partner relationships and flag them to the Core China/APAC Team.

  • Represent XPN at regional industry events across China and APAC, both to support active deals and to build XPN's local market presence.

  • Develop and maintain deep, current expertise in the XPN product to the point of being the go-to expert for partners and internal teams alike.

  • Work fluently across internal stakeholders (BD, Creator Success, Marketing, Data/Reporting) and external stakeholders (publisher teams, creator/MCN partners).

  • Game industry experience required based out of the China office (Beijing or Shanghai), in accordance with local in-office attendance requirements

• 3+ years in a customer success, account management, or partner management role — ideally in gaming, platform, adtech, or creator economy environments.

  • Fluent Mandarin and professional English.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage external partner relationships with a strategic, consultative approach — not purely reactive support.

  • Working knowledge of both the Chinese domestic platform landscape (Bilibili, Douyin, DouYu, Huya) and major global/international platforms (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok) — publishers are increasingly looking to expand reach beyond China, and this role needs to speak credibly to both sides of that expansion.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally across time zones with global teams, translating between local market realities and global program structures.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regionally for events and partner meetings across China and APAC.

  • Self-starter comfortable defining process in a role without an established playbook — this is a new function within XPN.

• Prior direct or adjacent BD/sales exposure — this role will occasionally carry commercial conversations, though it is not a quota-carrying sales position.
  • Familiarity with additional regional platforms (e.g. Chzzk/SOOP in Korea, Niconico in Japan) for publishers expanding into wider APAC.
  • Experience working with flat-fee or hybrid commercial models and the reporting expectations that come with them.

lists.content:
Modeling Depth

  • Advanced Degree in Statistics, machine learning or related areas. Experience in statistics/ML expertise with a track record of leading high-impact data science initiatives at scale of billions of transactions.

  • Hands-on experience creating, training and fine-tuning models not just integrating hosted model APIs. You should be able to walk through  the data, the objective, what broke, and the before/after evaluation numbers, and why the model did not perform as expected.

  • Experience owning models in production: deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining — with real latency budgets, not just research notebooks.

  • Production experience with classical ML for fraud/anomaly detection, recommendation, or churn/LTV (gradient boosting, deep learning, graph-based models).

    • Technology Familiarity

  • Supervised learning, transfer leaning on machine learning as well as neural networks

  • Basic LLM knowledge, especially how to use it and where not to use it.

  • MLOps foundations: feature stores, experiment tracking, model registries (MLflow/W&B-class), continuous training pipelines.

  • Model serving and inference optimization (vLLM-class serving, quantization).

• Publications, conference talks, or recognized open-source contributions to training/eval tooling .

  • Graph-based fraud detection (fraud rings, device/account linkage)..

  • Gaming, payments,  fraud, advertising  domain experience.

  • Hands-on, up-to-date experience with modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and accelerating day-to-day engineering work.

lists.content:
•  Architect and lead the design of Xsolla’s next-generation identity platform, supporting authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), and account federation across internal and external services.
  •  Develop high-performance Golang microservices that manage user identity, access tokens, and permission enforcement at global scale.
  •  Collaborate closely with security, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to embed Zero Trust principles and standardize access governance across services.
  •  Integrate modern IAM standards and protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SCIM) to enhance developer experience and partner integrations.
  •  Mentor and coach engineering teams on secure service design, identity best practices, and cross-service communication patterns.
  •  Partner with product teams to ensure that identity-related features — such as player login, entitlement management, and account linking — are scalable, compliant, and user-friendly.
  •  Define and enforce API and data security standards, supporting compliance initiatives.
  •  Evaluate and integrate third-party identity frameworks or open-source solutions (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Ory, ForgeRock) as part of Xsolla’s hybrid identity strategy.

•  10+ years in backend or systems engineering, including 5+ years designing and implementing authentication and authorization services.
  •  Expert-level skills in Golang, with experience building and scaling distributed, event-driven microservices.
  •  Proven track record with identity federation, token management, and access control systems.
  •  In-depth understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, SCIM).
  •  Solid grasp of security principles, encryption, key management, and secrets management systems (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS).
  •  Experience building high-availability systems in Kubernetes-based environments using AWS, or GCP.
  •  Strong architectural vision with the ability to influence cross-team design and technology direction.
  •  Excellent communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams.

• Experience building or contributing to identity systems for gaming or SaaS ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, ReBAC/ABAC models, and policy-as-code (OPA, AuthZ frameworks).
  • Background in security engineering, DevSecOps, or compliance automation.
  • Contributions to open-source Golang.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to take architectural ownership of the agent-readable Shop Builder platform. This is the most senior individual contributor role on the DevX and AI team, and the decisions you make here — which surfaces to expose, which formats to support, which standards to set — will bind the platform for years.
You are not a manager, but your influence is org-wide. You define how developers and AI agents interact with Shop Builder's foundational capabilities: UI as Data, custom blocks, themes, data binding, catalog, payments. You are the technical authority on what the platform exposes and how, and you are deeply hands-on with the hardest parts of that work.
 
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global payments and commerce platform for the games industry, used by thousands of publishers to monetize, distribute, and operate their titles worldwide. Shop Builder is Xsolla's storefront platform — used by publishers and game developers to launch and operate game shops, from straightforward catalog and webshops to fully custom storefronts built headless on our backend. For more information, visit xsolla.com.

You are the technical authority on what the platform exposes and how, and you are deeply hands-on with the hardest parts of that work.

 

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global payments and commerce platform for the games industry, used by thousands of publishers to monetize, distribute, and operate their titles worldwide. Shop Builder is Xsolla's storefront platform — used by publishers and game developers to launch and operate game shops, from straightforward catalog and webshops to fully custom storefronts built headless on our backend. For more information, visit xsolla.com.

The DevX and AI team owns the public APIs, documentation, and AI features that give developers — and AI agents — the full surface they need to customize and extend Shop Builder. lists.content:
• Own the technical architecture of the agent-readable Shop Builder platform: which APIs to expose, in what shape, through which surfaces (REST, SDK, MCP, CLI).

  • Define the interface contracts that LLMs and developers interact with — React component APIs, custom block schemas, theme tokens, data binding formats — and maintain them with the rigor of a public API.

  • Design and lead delivery of the MCP server that allows AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to build, deploy, and operate Shop Builder storefronts end-to-end without the editor in the loop.

  • Architect the CLI and local development environment: how developers scaffold projects, iterate locally, preview changes, and push to production.

  • Define the deploy, versioning, and rollback model for developer-published content — custom blocks, themes, and layouts.

  • Design the sandbox and preview environment system so agents and developers can iterate without touching live partner sites.

  • Set the documentation standard: written for LLMs and humans as first-class users, maintained from single canonical sources and published to every surface (CLI help, dev docs, MCP tool descriptions, AI context).

  • Lead the eval harness architecture: how the team measures whether an LLM-generated block, theme, or layout is correct before it ships.

  • Collaborate with Principal/Staff Engineers across payments, auth, live ops, and catalog to pull inbound capabilities into coherent developer-facing surfaces.

  • Serve as the technical bar-raiser for the team: define code standards, review critical implementation decisions, and mentor the Tech Lead and engineers.

  • Contribute to hiring and define the technical culture of the team from day one.

• 10+ years of professional engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record as a Staff or Principal engineer who has shaped platforms, APIs, or developer tooling used by external builders.

  • Deep expertise in designing and shipping public APIs and SDKs, including versioning strategy, backwards compatibility, and developer ergonomics — strong opinions about what makes an API delightful vs. painful.

  • Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React — the primary interface language for LLMs and developers on this platform.

  • Hands-on experience building CLI tooling and local developer workflows (scaffolding, hot reload, file-based config, deploy commands).

  • Solid understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent agentic tool-use interfaces, and practical experience building tools that AI agents can reliably invoke.

  • Experience building systems at global scale on cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), with deep knowledge of containerization, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Ability to write and reason about LLM-friendly documentation and API surfaces: you understand that token-efficiency, predictability, and schema clarity matter as much as human readability.

  • Exceptional technical communication: clear RFCs and ADRs, productive architecture reviews, and the ability to explain second-order consequences to engineering and business leadership.

  • Comfort operating in a greenfield context — you define the structure rather than inherit it.

• Prior experience in game tech, digital commerce, or storefront platforms — understanding the publisher/developer relationship and headless vs. hosted deployment patterns.

  • Experience building platforms where AI agents are a first-class user: MCP servers, LLM tool registries, agent eval pipelines.

  • Familiarity with Figma's plugin/component API, design token standards, and design-to-code pipelines.

  • Contributions to open-source developer tooling, SDK frameworks, or API standards.

  • Background in block or extension marketplace design: sandboxing third-party code, schema validation, publisher ecosystems.

  • Published technical writing, conference talks, or influential community presence in developer tooling or AI-native development.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT US
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Product / Web Designer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working with our HQ Design team. This role is the design half of a two-person build pair: you and the Partnerships Backend Engineer take an inbound partnerships inquiry and turn it into something a player actually sees — a co-branded web shop, a campaign landing page, a creator or affiliate destination page — and ship it together.
You will design conversion-oriented commerce surfaces for the Traffic Source Partners we onboard, adapt Xsolla and partner brand systems into one coherent look per campaign, and build a reusable component library so the next campaign launches faster than the last one. You will hand off to engineering with real specs and then review the implementation until it matches.
This is an entry-level design role with a live audience. We care more about your portfolio and your eye than your years of experience — recent graduates and self-taught designers with strong work are welcome. If you like designing things that get measured, and you want to see your work convert real traffic in APAC markets, we would love to hear from you.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Design partner-facing surfaces
Design the frontend surfaces created for Traffic Source partnerships: co-branded web shop themes, campaign landing pages, affiliate and creator destination pages, promotional banners, and in-shop merchandising.
Design responsive, mobile-first layouts with the purchase funnel in mind — clarity, hierarchy, trust signals, and a short path to checkout.
Adapt Xsolla brand guidelines and each partner's brand into a single coherent visual system per campaign, without breaking either.
Localise and adapt designs for APAC markets, accounting for language length, local conventions, and regional payment and merchandising context.
Ship with engineering
Work directly with the Partnerships Backend Engineer to take designs from Figma into working frontend — provide specs, states, breakpoints, tokens, and exported assets, then review the build until it matches the design.
Build and maintain a reusable component and template library so new partner campaigns can be assembled rather than designed from scratch.
QA implemented pages across browsers and devices and raise the gaps.
Supporting work
Create supporting collateral for partnerships inquiries: pitch visuals, one-pagers, deck slides, and social or creator kit assets.
Collaborate with HQ Design, follow and contribute to the Xsolla design system, and keep design files, naming, and handoff documentation organised.
Take feedback constructively from HQ Design, Partnerships, and partners, and iterate quickly.
Track work in Jira and keep design documentation current in Confluence.
REQUIREMENTS
1–4 years of experience in product, web, or UI design, or a strong portfolio of personal, freelance, or academic work. A portfolio is required for this application.
Proficiency in Figma — components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
Solid grounding in layout, typography, visual hierarchy, colour, and responsive / mobile-first design.
Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for asset production.
An understanding of what makes a landing page convert, and a willingness to have your design judged on that.
Able to work within an existing design system and brand guidelines rather than around them.
Attention to detail and a high standard of quality in design execution.
English sufficient for daily collaboration with the HQ Design team; Russian for day-to-day work in the Vladivostok office.
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Vladivostok for an onsite role.
NICE TO HAVE
Basic HTML and CSS — enough to spec accurately and QA an implementation.
Motion and micro-interaction work (After Effects, Framer Motion, Rive, Lottie).
Experience designing e-commerce, storefront, or checkout flows.
Experience with marketing landing pages, A/B testing, or conversion optimisation.
Illustration, 3D, or custom asset creation skills.
Familiarity with the gaming industry, creator and influencer marketing, or affiliate campaigns.
Additional languages relevant to APAC coverage (Korean, Chinese, Japanese).
Professional education in design or a related field.
BENEFITS
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT YOU
The Xsolla Offerwall puts rewarded offers in front of players inside the games and apps of our publishers. A player opens the wall, picks an offer, completes it, and earns in-game currency. Whether they do depends on what they see: the offer card, the creative, the video, the playable, and the reward moment.
Those units come from several places. Some are native offers we render ourselves. Some arrive as VAST video, HTML or MRAID creatives, or OpenRTB Native assets from demand partners. Each format has its own rules, and each one has to look right in a publisher's game, on a phone, without breaking what the advertiser sent.
You'll own how offerwall ads look and perform. You'll decide which formats we support and how they render. You'll design what the player sees, and turn that into specs engineers can build from. You'll measure whether a change made players more likely to engage, and you'll use AI to make better creative faster than a manual process allows.

lists.content:
Ad experience and creative

  • Own the look and feel of every ad unit in the offerwall: offer cards, detail pages, video, playables, interstitials, and the reward flow.

  • Set creative standards for advertisers and publishers: layouts, asset specs, safe areas, aspect ratios, and branding rules.

  • Balance three groups who want different things: players want a clean experience, publishers want it to match their game, and advertisers want their brand shown properly.

    • oRTB formats and rendering

    • Define how we support VAST, HTML and MRAID, and OpenRTB Native inside the offerwall, across Web, iOS, Android, and Unity.

    • Write the requirements for format support: which VAST events we track, which MRAID calls we allow, and how Native assets map into our own templates.

    • Work with Engineering on creative QA and rejection rules, so broken or non-compliant creatives get caught before a player sees them.

      • Design to engineering

      • Turn ideas into Figma designs and prototypes that engineers can build without guessing.

      • Write PRDs and acceptance criteria that cover states, edge cases, and device differences, not just the happy path.

      • Work with our designers on the offerwall's design system, and keep it consistent across publishers and platforms.

        • Experimentation and performance

        • Run A/B tests on layouts, creative treatments, and formats, and read the results yourself.

        • Track the metrics that show whether the ad experience works: CTR, video completion rate, offer start and completion rates, IPM, and eCPM.

        • Turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap, and explain the tradeoffs to Engineering, Demand, and leadership.

          • AI in creative and workflow

          • Find where AI can improve ad units: generating creative variants, adapting assets to new formats, auto-cropping and localization, and checking creative quality.

          • Use AI tools in your own work: prototyping, writing specs, analyzing test results, and getting from idea to something testable faster.

            • Cross-functional work

            • Work with Engineering, Design, Demand, Publisher Success, and Data every week.

            • Give the Demand team clear creative guidelines they can share with advertisers.

            • Bring what publishers and advertisers say back into the roadmap, in a form engineers can act on.

• Around 5 years of product management experience, with a significant part of it in AdTech.

  • Hands-on experience owning ad design or ad experience: ad units, creative formats, or how ads render in an app or game.

  • Working knowledge of oRTB ad formats. You know how VAST, HTML and MRAID, and OpenRTB Native creatives work, what breaks them, and what the specs allow.

  • Comfortable with data. You can design an A/B test, read the result, and write SQL or use a BI tool to answer your own questions.

  • You write clear specs. Engineers should be able to build from what you write without coming back to ask what you meant.

  • Good visual judgment. You can tell why one layout works and another doesn't, and explain it in terms of player behavior.

  • Clear communication with engineers, designers, and commercial teams.

  • Based in Los Angeles or elsewhere in the US, and able to work across US time zones.

• Experience working with AI. This one matters a lot to us. Show us how you've used AI tools such as Claude, Midjourney, or Figma AI to make ads, prototype products, or get more done. Come ready to show a real example.
  • Experience with offerwalls, rewarded ads, or rewarded video.
  • Experience designing in Figma: building prototypes and engineering-ready designs yourself, not just reviewing someone else's.
  • Experience in mobile gaming or app monetization.
  • Familiarity with ad SDKs, mediation, and how they render third-party creatives.

• A demand partner starts sending VAST wrappers that time out on Android. You look at the VAST chain, work out where it's slow, and agree a timeout and fallback rule with Engineering.

  • Offer completion rates on one publisher are 30% below the network average. You compare their wall against others, find the reward value is hidden below the fold on smaller phones, and mock up a fix in Figma that afternoon.

  • An advertiser wants to run a playable in the offerwall. You check what their MRAID creative needs, decide what we'll support, and write the spec.

  • You use an AI image model to generate 20 variants of an offer card's hero image, test four of them, and share the winner and the lift with the team.

  • Engineering asks how Native title and icon assets should behave when an advertiser sends nothing. You answer the same day, with the rule written into the spec.

• Offerwall engagement improves: higher CTR, offer start rate, and completion rate, backed by test results rather than claims.

  • The formats we support render correctly across platforms, and creative rejections and rendering bugs go down.

  • Engineering builds from your specs and designs without long back-and-forth.

  • Advertisers and publishers have clear creative guidelines, and the Demand team uses them.

  • AI is part of how the team makes and tests creative, not a side experiment.

About You
You own the Subscriptions roadmap. Your core job runs end to end: research and discovery, prioritization, pushing work into development, delivery, and then educating the sales team and preparing the documentation that ships with each release.
That means staying close to the publishers who run subscription businesses on Xsolla and to their subscribers. You find what moves retention and revenue, decide what gets built and in what order, and drive it from idea through delivery and adoption.
Subscriptions depend on many products across Xsolla. You'll work with a tech lead and engineers, and coordinate across Payments, Anti-fraud, Auth, Catalog, Shop Builder, LiveOps, Analytics, and others.
 
What we're building
Xsolla Subscriptions is a subscription monetization engine for games that covers the full lifecycle. Publishers use it to power battle passes, premium memberships, season passes, and other recurring mechanics — creating plans, running trials, and handling renewals, failed payments, and cancellations. Track subscribers, churn, and revenue in one place. As merchant of record, Xsolla also covers global recurring payments, tax, refunds, and chargebacks.
The team owns that whole surface: plans and pricing, renewals and retry logic, trials and grace periods, churn and recovery, and the subscriber and publisher experience.

lists.content:
• Research and discovery. Study competitors, interview publishers and partners to uncover their needs, and dig into subscriber and payment data to find what's worth building.

  • Collect requirements and design features. Turn findings into clear requirements and feature designs.

  • Own the roadmap. Decide what gets built, in what order, and why. Maintain a clear rationale the team and stakeholders can rely on.

  • Deliver and coordinate. Drive features to production and keep the cross-product dependencies moving.

  • Post-delivery support. Support marketing materials preparation, train the sales team, and prepare integration-team materials and public documentation.

• 4+ years in product, with real time on subscription, billing, or payments products.

  • A solid understanding of subscription economics and lifecycle, ideally in games — battle passes, premium memberships, season passes, and others.

  • Comfort with billing mechanics: renewals, proration, dunning and retry, grace periods, refunds, chargebacks, and tax.

  • A track record of taking features from research to shipped, and making prioritization calls without full information.

  • Systems thinking: you understand how a pricing or billing decision compounds across many publishers and their subscribers.

    • Daily use of AI tools is assumed and expected. It is a significant plus if you have a strategic vision for applying machine learning to core subscription challenges—such as churn prediction, retry timing, and dynamic pricing—or possess hands-on experience in the field.

Subscriptions are one of the fastest-growing forms of monetization in games — predictable revenue, low overhead, strong loyalty — and now outpace one-off and in-game purchases in growth. Small gains in recovery or conversion have a huge impact across thousands of publishers. You'll own a high-impact product with direct visibility to engineering and business leadership.

About You

You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.

This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

• Research and discovery. Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.

  • Coordinate the roadmap. Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.

  • Write product requirements. Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.

  • Manage delivery. Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.

  • Track what matters. Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.

  • Keep everyone connected. Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

• Product experience. 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.

  • Customer insight. You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.

  • Clear writing. You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.

  • Engineering partnership. You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.

  • Cross-team communication. You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.

  • Adaptability. You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.

  • Video game marketing. You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.

  • Creator platform familiarity. You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

• Marketplace or platform experience. You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
  • Partner commercial models. Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
  • Campaign attribution. Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
  • Data comfort. You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT YOU
We're looking for a Production focused Project Manager who is organized, communicative, and relentlessly detail-oriented. Someone who brings structure and clarity to creative and print production projects and keeps designers, vendors, and stakeholders aligned from brief through delivery. You are a natural coordinator who ensures nothing falls through the cracks: timelines are tracked, approvals are documented, and stakeholders always know where things stand.
This role sits within the Experiential Marketing Team and focuses on the production of printed materials, graphics, video, and other marketing collateral, with event and campaign collateral as the primary area of ownership. You will manage the full production lifecycle across all B2B and B2C event projects: signage and booth graphics, printed collateral, branded merchandise, digital and video assets, and every physical or visual touchpoint that brings a brand to life at an event. You will serve as the primary internal point of contact for production-related requests, working cross-functionally with designers, video and content teams, external print and fabrication vendors, the Project Manager for the US, and other internal stakeholders to keep creative, operational, and event workstreams moving in sync.
The right person for this role has an exceptional eye for detail, catches errors before they reach print, and is proactive in surfacing risks, delays, and blockers. You are consistent in written communication, confident in managing multiple deadlines at once, and comfortable holding vendors and internal teams to specifications, brand standards, and quality expectations.

lists.content:
• Manage production timelines, budgets, and approvals for print, graphic, and video projects from brief to final delivery

  • Coordinate with designers, videographers, and external vendors to ensure assets meet specs, brand guidelines, and deadlines

  • Run proofing and quality checks on files, colors, copy, dimensions, and finishes before anything goes to print or publication

  • Source quotes, compare vendors, and manage purchase orders and delivery logistics, including shipping to event venues

  • Maintain a central tracker of assets, versions, approvals, and open issues so stakeholders always have visibility

  • Document decisions and feedback rounds clearly to avoid rework and miscommunication

  • Flag risks early and propose solutions to protect timelines and quality

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of global experiential campaigns.

  • Define project scopes, deliverables, and milestones with stakeholders for all new operational projects

  • Maintain and monitor detailed project timelines using Jira.

  • Coordinate communication between global marketing and event teams.

  • Partner with creative, production, and marketing to align on deliverables.

  • Facilitate project meetings, document outcomes, and follow up on action items.

  • Manage budget tracking, reporting, and forecasting in Jira and Google Sheets.

  • Support budget development, tracking, and reconciliation with VP and Ops Manager.

  • Partner with finance for real-time budget visibility.

  • Monitor costs and identify risks or opportunities for savings.

  • Track KPIs and project data through Anaplan or equivalent tools.

  • Maintain Anaplan dashboards for forecasting and event scoring.

  • Administer Jira workspaces, ensuring data accuracy and reporting compliance.

  • Build dashboards and tools to track KPIs (budget efficiency, process adherence, etc.).

  • Prepare post-event reports on ROI, engagement, and learnings.

• 4 - 6 years of project management experience in marketing, events, or experiential roles.

  • Proven record of managing multi-stakeholder global projects.

  • Proficient in Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)

  • Strong organization and multitasking abilities.

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).

  • Analytical, data-driven approach with actionable insights.

  • Background in gaming, tech, or entertainment industries preferred.

  • Self-starter with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Team-oriented and thrives in fast-paced, global environments.

  • Passionate about storytelling and creating immersive brand experiences.

• Foster relationships with Tier 1 and local media outlets and partners across Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and the broader APAC region.

  • Contribute to marketing communications plans, encompassing strategy, goals, budget, and tactics.

  • Develop a strategic media relations plan to secure high-profile placements in print, broadcast, and online media across Japanese- and English-language outlets, with additional coverage in regional  games, fintech, and web3 events.

  • Assist in coordinating all public relations activities, including event logistics and speaking opportunities at key regional games, fintech, and web3 events.

  • Collaborate closely with the integrated marketing manager to create engaging content for audiences across traditional and new media platforms, with sensitivity to regional cultural norms and platform preferences (e.g., LINE, X/Twitter Japan, Naver).

  • Utilize existing media relationships and cultivate new contacts within the business, technology, and gaming industry media across the APAC region, including key Japanese outlets such as Famitsu, 4Gamer, Dengeki, and Game Watch.

  • Manage media inquiries and interview requests.

  • Craft content for press releases, bylined articles, and presentation scripts.

  • Continually evaluate opportunities for partnerships, sponsorships, and advertising within the region's gaming and entertainment ecosystem.

  • Establish relationships with thought leaders, industry associations, and gaming ecosystem stakeholders to increase industry awareness across APAC.

  • Keep abreast of industry trends affecting clients and the APAC gaming market, and make appropriate recommendations regarding the communication strategy surrounding them
  • Engage in content creation focusing on though leadership, creativity, and maintaining a content bank of editorial ideas aligned with regional market plans.

• BA/MA degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related discipline.

  • 6-8 years of proven track record in strategizing and executing successful public relations campaigns at both domestic and international levels, with meaningful APAC market experience, including Japan.

  • Strong networks with both local and international business and industry media outlets across the APAC region, including Japan. Relationships with content creators/influencers are an added advantage.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills – short form, long form, branded content, light ad copywriting.

  • PR event planning and execution experience within the APAC region, particularly Japan and South Korea.

  • Expertise in handling crisis communications.

  • Prior work experience in the video game industry is a prerequisite, and fintech experience would be a bonus.
  • Proficiency in localizing press releases for the Japanese market and an understanding of cultural nuances across the region.

    • Freedom to Act:

    • Ability to self-motivate, work independently across time zones, and contribute effectively within a globally distributed team environment.

      • Size and Complexity:

      • A proven track record of successfully managing a company's reputation and launching multiple products, while consistently projecting a positive, professional image of the organization across diverse APAC markets.

        • Interaction:

        • Willingness and ability to undertake special projects.

        • Ability to handle confidential information with the utmost level of professionalism.

        • Excellent performance in cross-functional project teams and with external vendors.

          • External Relationships:

          • Understanding of the comprehensive range of skills required to manage customer-centric relationships with partners and regional gaming ecosystem stakeholders.

As the successful candidate will be working across the APAC region, knowledge and understanding of Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), as well as other local data privacy laws and business practices, will be essential. Fluency in Japanese and English is required. Proficiency in Korean or Mandarin is a bonus.

At Xsolla, we know it isn't just about the paycheck. That's why our Benefits Program is designed to meet and enhance our team's physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

We are all about personal and professional growth! Every Xsolla employee has a customized career roadmap, curated by the employee alongside their manager, that helps align company goals with individualized plans. To foster your growth at Xsolla, we offer in-house training, independent study, conference attendance, and higher education opportunities.

descriptionBody:
ABOUT YOU
We are seeking a seasoned and talented Public Relations Manager to join Xsolla's Global Marketing team! In this role, you will support and make significant contributions to the planning, collaboration, execution, and measurement of our PR & Media Relations Campaigns in the Asia-Pacific region.

Our goal is to foster and enhance a favorable image of our company among employees, potential candidates, clients, partners, influencers, industry leaders and gamers within the region. If you excel in writing, technology, and customer service, and you have a strong understanding of games tech, fintech, and forums, this role might be for you. We value team players who listen well, collaborate seamlessly, and are not hesitant to share innovative new ideas. As an individual, you should be responsible, trustworthy, and proactive.
