lists.content:
• Partner with the regional Sales team to ensure product knowledge, positioning, and value articulation are effectively communicated in all customer interactions.

  • Partnering with Product Marketing: Deliver localized enablement sessions, playbooks, and deal-support resources aligned with the global sales enablement strategy. Support go-to-market readiness for new product launches and updates, ensuring local alignment with global product narratives. Maintain awareness of regional competitive offerings and tailor enablement materials to local market needs.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Product Growth Support leadership to identify and accelerate high-impact opportunities.

  • Provide tactical deal support by aligning customer requirements with product capabilities and value propositions.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor in deal strategy discussions, helping teams overcome objections and optimize monetization outcomes.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when unique partner requests or technical blockers arise.

  • Monitor and report on product adoption, deal velocity, and partner engagement within the region.

  • Coordinate with the Sales Team to ensure data accuracy within Salesforce and related systems to ensure visibility into pipeline health and performance metrics.

  • Share recurring insights on regional trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities with Product Growth Support leadership.

  • Contribute to business reviews with structured data and qualitative feedback to guide prioritization and resource allocation.

  • Act as a liaison between regional field teams and Product leadership to communicate partner feedback and product improvement opportunities.

  • Participate in structured feedback loops to ensure that customer use cases and regional needs inform roadmap planning.

  • Support documentation of use cases, blockers, and success stories to help refine global product strategy.

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing on refining messaging and positioning for regional relevance.

  • Adopt and maintain best practices in tools and workflows (Salesforce, Jira, internal dashboards, AI-driven analytics).

  • Ensure consistent communication and coordination with counterparts in other regions to promote global alignment.

  • Contribute to process improvements and tool optimization that enhance deal efficiency and data visibility.

  • Participate in global readiness meetings and feedback sessions to share learnings and standardize execution.

  • Stay informed on local industry trends, competitor activities, and partner sentiment to anticipate changes in market dynamics.

  • Represent Xsolla’s monetization products in customer and partner discussions, trade shows, or industry events within the region.

  • Provide qualitative intelligence to leadership to support market-entry decisions, product prioritization, and pricing strategies.

• Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Technical Account Manager, Presales/Solutions Engineer, or similar role that combines sales pipeline exposure with technical or product fluency, 5+ years

  • Experience designing or delivering enablement/training materials for sales or non-technical audiences

  • Ability to synthesize qualitative partner/market feedback into structured insights for global stakeholders"

  • Experience in the PC and mobile gaming industry (development, publishing or platforms)

  • Understanding of monetization models in the local market including Subscriptions and LiveOps

  • Awareness of D2C cases: Web Shops, external top-ups, in-game campaigns

  • Experience interacting with B2B clients and/or publishers

  • Native-level Korean proficiency required for client communication, stakeholder management, and business documentation..

  • Strong English proficiency required for collaboration with global teams and international stakeholders

• Work experience in an international company

  • Experience in bringing a global product to the Japanese market

  • Comfort working with CRM/reporting tools (Salesforce or similar) and interpreting sales/product data

  • Understanding of legislation regarding advertising, gacha, children and online payments

• Own Vulnerability Management - Lead triage of bug bounty reports and scanner findings. Set severity standards, drive escalation policy, and ensure remediation SLAs are met across teams.

  • Lead Security Assessments - Plan and conduct in-depth security assessments and penetration tests of web applications, APIs, and services. Define assessment scope and methodology.

  • Drive Threat Modeling - Facilitate threat modeling sessions with engineering teams. Identify trust boundaries, data flows, and attack surfaces early in the design phase, and embed the practice into the SDLC.

  • Own AppSec Tooling Strategy - Select, operate, and tune SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets-scanning tooling. Design noise-reduction and auto-triage workflows; integrate security gates into CI/CD.

  • Lead Secure Code Reviews - Perform security-focused code reviews across PHP, Python, and Go codebases. Define secure coding guidelines and review checklists for engineering teams.

  • Mentor and Educate - Coach junior security specialists, run internal security training, and champion security awareness among developers.

  • Write Clear Security Documentation - Document findings, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance in a way engineering teams can act on. Set the documentation standard for the team.

• 4+ years in application security or a closely related security engineering role, with demonstrable ownership of AppSec programs or major initiatives.

  • Deep Web Security Expertise - Expert-level understanding of vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 and well beyond: SSRF, deserialization, request smuggling, OAuth/OIDC flaws, business logic abuse). You understand root causes, exploitation chains, and realistic impact in production systems.

  • Offensive Testing Proficiency - Extensive hands-on experience with Burp Suite and manual testing methodology. You can find vulnerabilities that scanners miss and chain low-severity issues into meaningful impact.

  • Code Fluency - Comfortable reading and auditing code in at least one of: PHP, Python, Go, JavaScript. Able to trace data flows across services and spot vulnerable patterns without runtime access.

  • Secure SDLC Experience - Practical experience embedding security into development workflows: security requirements, design review, CI/CD security gates, and developer enablement.

  • Risk Communication - You can calculate and defend real severity, push back on inflated findings, and explain risk to both engineers and leadership in their own language.

  • Analytical Thinking - You reason through problems methodically and can explain not just what a vulnerability is, but why it exists, how it is exploited, and what fixing it actually requires.

  • Ownership and Follow-Through - You drive findings to resolution across team boundaries without being asked.

• Track record in bug bounty programs (accepted reports on major platforms) or notable CTF results;

  • Strong automation skills - Python or Go for building internal security tooling;

  • Experience securing cloud-native environments - GCP preferred; Kubernetes security a plus;

  • Advanced certifications - OSWE, OSCP, BSCP, or GWAPT;

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or other regulated environments (PCI DSS familiarity);

  • CVE credits, public security research, or conference talks.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for two platform products:

  • Xsolla ID is the identity and authentication platform behind sign-in, account management and SSO across Xsolla products.

  • Xsolla ZK is Web3 wallet infrastructure: smart wallets and account abstraction on a zkSync-based L2.

    • Both products sit on users' most sensitive flows, logging in and signing transactions, and other Xsolla teams build on top of them.

    WHAT YOU WILL OWN

    • The backend services of your product area end to end: design, implementation, release and production operation, including on-call

    • Architecture across services: service boundaries, integration contracts and data ownership. You make these decisions and justify them in writing

    • Reliability and security of critical flows: SLOs, failure handling, protection of user data and credentials

    • Service performance and cost under load

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design and build services and APIs (REST, gRPC) for authentication, account management and wallet operations

  • Define service boundaries and integration contracts with other Xsolla teams

  • Design data models and storage; optimize schemas and queries

  • Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows

  • Own observability: metrics, logs, tracing and alerting, and act on what production tells you

  • Take part in on-call, incident response and post-mortems

  • Improve the engineering environment: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, testing

  • Review code

  • Set up and maintain AI tooling in the repositories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: rules, context, harness) so the team uses it effectively

• Language and platform

    • 5+ years of commercial backend development

    • Go: idiomatic code, concurrency (goroutines, channels, context and cancellation), memory and performance profiling (pprof)

      • Data

      • Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL): schema design, indexes, query plans, transactions and isolation levels, safe migrations

      • Caching (Redis): when to cache, invalidation, consistency trade-offs

        • Distributed systems

        • Service architecture and distributed-systems trade-offs: consistency, availability, idempotency, retries, failure modes

        • Asynchronous messaging and event-driven design (Kafka, RabbitMQ or NATS): delivery guarantees, ordering, reprocessing

          • APIs

          • Designing REST and gRPC APIs: versioning, backward compatibility, contract documentation (OpenAPI / Swagger, Protobuf)

            • Security and identity

            • Application security: common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10), secrets management, safe handling of user data

            • OAuth 2.0 / OIDC from the server side: flows, tokens, sessions

              • Operations

              • Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at the level of deploying and debugging your own services

              • Observability (we use Datadog; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Graylog or OpenTelemetry also counts): metrics, logs, tracing and alerting; diagnosing incidents in production

                • Engineering practices

                • Testing: unit, integration, contract

                • Git, CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar)

                  • AI-assisted engineering

                  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for development and review, including configuring them for a repository

                    • English

                    • Reading technical documentation in English

• Web3 backend experience: blockchain integration, wallet infrastructure, account abstraction

  • High-load systems

  • Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code

  • NoSQL databases (MongoDB or similar)

  • Domain experience in gaming, e-commerce, fintech or payments

    • HOW WE WORK

    • Decisions in writing. Significant technical decisions are written up as an RFC or ADR that lays out the options and trade-offs. We discuss the document, not a blank whiteboard.

    • AI is part of everyday engineering. We use AI coding tools for development and review, and we treat configuring them for a codebase as real engineering work.

      • HOW WE HIRE

      1. Intro call. Your background, your motivation and the role.

      2. Technical interview. Built directly on the What you will own and Required sections above. We won't ask about anything this posting doesn't promise.

      3. Bar raiser. An engineer from outside the hiring team checks that you raise the overall engineering bar.

      THE TEAM

      You will work alongside product managers, designers, backend and frontend engineers, QA and DevOps.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and maintain backend services that power core products and platforms.
  • Develop event-driven systems using Go and Kafka.
  • Build scalable microservices in containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Drive architecture decisions that improve performance, resiliency, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and QA to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Own your code in production, monitor, debug, and continuously improve service performance and reliability.
  • Write automated tests and follow CI/CD best practices to ensure high-quality deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to support production systems and respond to incidents.

• 5+ years of backend development experience in Go or a similar language.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and event-based communication.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and drive resolution.

• Background in gaming, payments, or commerce systems.
  • Experience in adtech or offer monetization platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms.
  • Experience with Redis or other in-memory data stores.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse, Postgres, or other analytical/OLAP/OLTP databases.
  • Prior experience working on internal platforms or developer-facing tools.

lists.content:
• Build and ship reliable, secure and scalable backend services in Go.
  • Own features from design to deployment, with attention to maintainability, security and performance.
  • Design and build APIs and SDKs used by Business Account frontends, microfrontends and other Xsolla teams.
  • Build and maintain identity flows such as user creation, login, MFA, SSO and token validation across multiple accounts and clients.
  • Design multi-tenant services with clear data isolation and per-account configuration.
  • Take part in architecture discussions and write or review ADRs.
  • Refactor legacy code to improve structure and efficiency without breaking existing features.
  • Own production readiness with Datadog: dashboards, monitors and alerts, APM and tracing, log analysis, incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Write clear, testable, well-documented code, with a focus on quality and automation.
  • Use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) every day to design, build, test and refactor code faster without lowering quality.
  • Add AI-assisted code review on top of manual review, check AI-generated code carefully, and help the team set good practices for AI-driven development.
  • Work with product, frontend, design and platform teams to agree on goals and deliver end to end.
  • Contribute to technical scoping and estimation.
  • Reduce technical debt and keep improving the developer experience.
  • Mentor engineers and give constructive code reviews.

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Go experience in production.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, including schema design and query performance.
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs (gRPC is a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Comfortable with Git and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization basics: OAuth2, JWT, sessions and tokens.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools, ideally Datadog: metrics, logs, APM/traces and alerting.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in daily work, and the judgment to review, test and correct what they produce.
  • Basic understanding of cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred).
  • Working knowledge of frontend technologies, especially React.
  • Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience building scalable, secure login or identity platforms (Login-as-a-Service).
  • Deep knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, MFA, and session and token management.
  • Experience with social login, SSO and federated identity.
  • Experience designing multi-tenant identity systems with isolation and configurability.
  • Experience delivering developer-friendly APIs, SDKs and integration docs.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, SLOs and error budgets.
  • Experience with B2B platforms, partner portals or marketplaces.
  • Experience setting up AI workflows for a team, such as agents, custom skills or prompts, automated MR review, or AI-assisted testing.

lists.content:
Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

    • Backlog & Roadmap Management

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.

  • Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

    • Change Management & Communication

  • Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.

  • Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.

  • Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.

  • Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

    • Operational Improvement

  • Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.

  • Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.

  • Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.

  • Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.

Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.

  • Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.

  • Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.

  • Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.

Strong Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.

  • Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.

  • Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

    • Highly Organized

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.

  • Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

    • Diligent & Proactive

  • Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.

  • Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.

  • Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.

  • Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

    • Strategic & Operational Thinking

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

  • Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.

  • Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.

    •  
    Preferred Expenrience
     

  • Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.

  • Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.

  • Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience in gaming, payments, e-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

You will be the operational bridge between Marketing, Product Marketing, SEO, Performance Marketing, Product, Design, Copywriting, Engineering, DataOps, DevOps, Legal and Events. East Coast preferred.

  • Act as operational lead for the CMS and publishing systems behind xsolla.com.

  • Work hands-on: build, update and publish directly in the CMS, while leading Web Ops and coordinating Product, Design, Development, SEO, DataOps and DevOps.

  • Partner with Product on template improvements and contributor workflows.

  • Keep templates, metadata, SEO implementation and UX standards consistent.

  • Support migrations and help the web ecosystem scale operationally.

  • Own operational outcomes for go-to-market and lead-generation workflows, including meeting-booking experiences, lead capture and routing, and Pardot and Salesforce integrations (current tooling includes Chili Piper).

  • Resolve issues directly or coordinate with Marketing Operations and Salesforce admins.

  • Keep these systems aligned with Marketing, Sales, Events and campaign execution.

    • Cross-functional Leadership

  • Be the go-to web lead for Integrated Marketing and go-to-market stakeholders.

  • Run recurring syncs, launch planning and implementation alignment across Marketing, PMM, Sales, PR, Events, Design and Engineering.

  • Align day-to-day execution with platform capabilities and the Product roadmap.

    • UX and Analytics

  • Provide UX feedback and user-journey recommendations across web initiatives.

  • Work with Design and Product to improve information architecture, navigation, usability and conversion flows.

  • Partner with SEO, Analytics and DataOps to track engagement and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Monitor traffic, engagement, conversion, booking performance and publishing velocity.

• 6–8+ years in web, digital experience or website operations roles, including at least 2–3 years leading cross-functional launches or running a large multi-site website, ideally at a B2B or technology company.

  • Hands-on experience running a CMS and publishing workflow at scale, including templates, metadata and SEO implementation, and comfort building and publishing pages yourself.

  • Technical web fluency: not a developer, but able to troubleshoot and tell whether an issue is content, CMS configuration, analytics, infrastructure, Product or Development work.

  • Experience with digital asset management (DAM) and content governance.

  • Working knowledge of marketing and lead-generation tooling such as Salesforce, Pardot (Account Engagement) and Chili Piper.

  • A strong UX eye and comfort using analytics to find problems and prove improvements.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional launches and keep many stakeholders aligned without direct authority.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and a bias for reliable execution.

  • Nice to have: Experience with website migrations, experimentation and A/B testing, or the video game industry.

• Launches ship on time, high quality and release-ready.

  • Website engagement and effectiveness improve over time.

  • Publishing is efficient and uninterrupted.

  • Stakeholders feel supported and aligned.

lists.content:
WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • The frontend of your product area end to end: shaping tasks with Product and Design, implementation, release and production monitoring

  • Technical decisions for that frontend. You make them and justify them in writing, rather than only implementing someone else's

  • The architecture of frontend applications and the shared UI library / SDK that other teams build on

  • Measurable frontend quality: performance, reliability and security of user flows

    • WHAT YOU WILL DO

    • Design and build user flows: sign-in, account management, wallet onboarding and transaction signing

    • Track how these flows behave in production (errors, performance, drop-offs) and act on what you see

    • Make architectural decisions for frontend applications and document them

    • Develop the shared component library and frontend SDKs used by other Xsolla teams

    • Agree API contracts with backend engineers, including error handling, retries and edge cases

    • Own performance budgets: Core Web Vitals and bundle size

    • Improve the engineering environment: build, linters, tests, CI

    • Review code

    • Set up and maintain AI tooling in the repositories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: rules, context, harness) so the team uses it effectively

Language and platform

  • 5+ years of commercial frontend development

  • TypeScript in strict mode: generics, utility types, discriminated unions, typing module boundaries and external data

  • JavaScript at the platform level: event loop, asynchrony, closures, memory. You can find a leak and explain its cause

    • Frameworks and state

    • Deep experience with React: rendering model, profiling, eliminating unnecessary re-renders

    • Separating local, server and global state, and justifying the choice of tool; reasoning about when SSR is worth it

      • UI quality and performance

      • Semantic, responsive, cross-browser layout; modern CSS (CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS)

      • Accessibility: ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader support

      • Performance analysis: profiling, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals

        • Integration and security

        • REST API integration: error handling, retries, request cancellation, contract alignment with backend

        • Web security fundamentals: XSS, CSRF, CSP, secure handling of tokens, sessions and user data

          • Engineering practices

          • Testing at the right level: unit, integration, E2E

          • Git, CI, Docker, linters and formatters

            • AI-assisted engineering

            • Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for development and review, including configuring them for a repository

              • English

              • Reading technical documentation in English

              • Experience in security-sensitive domains: authentication and identity (OAuth2/OIDC flows on the frontend), payments, crypto wallets

              • Web3 frontend: wallet integration (embedded and browser wallets), EIP-1193, EIP-6963, EIP-712; viem, wagmi, ethers.js

              • Next.js or Nuxt, SSR in production

              • Design systems and component API design, UI kits

              • Hybrid applications: WebView, React Native

Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer for two platform products:

  • Xsolla ID is the identity and authentication platform behind sign-in, account management and SSO across Xsolla products.

  • Xsolla ZK is Web3 wallet infrastructure: smart wallets and account abstraction on a zkSync-based L2.

Both products sit on users' most sensitive flows: logging in and signing transactions.

• Design, develop, and maintain modern, scalable, and responsive web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
  • Translate product designs and user stories into high-quality, functional UI components.
  • Optimize performance for speed and scalability across browsers and devices.
  • Refactor legacy code to align with current best practices and architectural patterns.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using modern frontend tooling.
  • Implement effective state management strategies and integrate with REST/GraphQL APIs.
  • Participate in and lead frontend design reviews and architecture discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Contribute to planning, estimation, and delivery tracking of new features and technical improvements.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, UI bugs, and UX inconsistencies.
  • Mentor peers, provide constructive code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

• 5+ years of professional experience in software development.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with React (and ideally TypeScript).
  • Deep knowledge of JavaScript/ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, and Web APIs.
  • Experience with responsive design systems and CSS-in-JS (e.g., Tailwind).
  • Familiarity with REST/GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and real-time data handling.
  • Comfortable working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile collaboration tools.
  • Exposure to testing frameworks such as Jest or Cypress.

• Experience with microfrontend or monorepo architectures.
  • Strong understanding of design systems and scalable component architectures.
  • Experience integrating third-party identity/auth systems (e.g., SSO, OAuth2).
  • Proficiency with Next.js, SSR/SSG, and hybrid rendering strategies.
  • A deep appreciation for UX polish, animation, and interaction design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Design, build and maintain scalable, responsive interfaces in React and TypeScript across multiple Business Accounts.
  • Build and own shared remote modules (Module Federation) that plug into several host apps, keeping them versioned, backward compatible and safe to deploy independently.
  • Build UI with our xui design system, and help improve it by contributing components and patterns.
  • Turn product designs and user stories into high-quality, accessible UI components.
  • Integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs, and implement clear state management.
  • Handle authentication and session flows between host apps and modules, including passing Publisher Account tokens securely.
  • Optimize performance, loading and caching across browsers and devices.
  • Refactor legacy code (for example, older React and react-router versions) toward current best practices.
  • Write clean, testable code and keep test coverage healthy.
  • Use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) every day to design, build, test and refactor code faster without lowering quality.
  • Add AI-assisted code review on top of manual review, check AI-generated code carefully, and help the team set good practices for AI-driven development.
  • Lead frontend design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions (ADRs).
  • Work closely with product, design, backend and partner teams such as Publisher Account and Site Builder to deliver features end to end.
  • Contribute to planning, estimation and delivery tracking.
  • Mentor engineers and give constructive code reviews.

• 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
  • Deep knowledge of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 and Web APIs.
  • Experience with design systems and CSS-in-JS (for example styled-components), and responsive layouts.
  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs; familiarity with WebSockets and real-time data.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in daily work, and the judgment to review, test and correct what they produce.
  • Comfortable with Git, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred) and agile workflows.
  • Experience with testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress or Playwright.
  • Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

• Experience with microfrontends (Module Federation) or monorepos.
  • Experience building or maintaining a shared component library or design system.
  • Experience with SSO, OAuth2 or JWT-based authentication across apps.
  • Experience working with a headless CMS.
  • Experience with Next.js, SSR/SSG or hybrid rendering.
  • Experience with B2B dashboards, admin tools or self-service portals.
  • Experience setting up AI workflows for a team, such as agents, custom skills or prompts, automated MR review, or AI-assisted testing.
  • A strong eye for UX polish, animation and interaction design.

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate complex requirements into intuitive user experiences.
  • Design, build and evolve scalable, high-performance frontend web applications
  • Participate in code reviews, share best practices, and help maintain high engineering standards within the frontend team.
  • Work closely with DevOps to streamline CI/CD pipelines, improve deployment reliability, and enhance observability through metrics and monitoring tools.
  • Own features end-to-end such as requirement refinement, implementation, testing, and delivery. Optimize frontend performance, focusing on loading times, rendering speed, and bundle efficiency.
  • Ensure cross-browser and multi-device compatibility while meeting accessibility (a11y) and usability standards.
  • Contribute to the modernization, refactoring, and continuous performance improvements to keep the platform scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product goals.
  • Contribute and enforce engineering best practices across coding, documentation, testing, and review processes.
  • Ensure strong automated test coverage and reliable CI/CD workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery predictability.
  • Own operational excellence, including incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Advocate for scalability, performance, security, and observability across the platform’s architecture and tooling.
  • Identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and communicate trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders.

• At least 2+ years of experience holding a senior frontend development title.
  • 7+ years of frontend software development experience with strong expertise in modern frontend frameworks at scale.
  • Experience building or leading frontend development for e-commerce, gaming, or monetization platforms
  • Extensive experience with Typescript, React, Redux or modern state management libraries.
  • Experience with module federation, component architecture, performance optimizations, accessibility, RSC, and SSR patterns.
  • Strong expertise in modern CSS frameworks and UX/UI design systems and principles.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and RESTful or RPC-style APIs integration and patterns.
  • Proficiency with Node.js and MongoDB for server-side functionality.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest) and end-to-end testing (Playwright/Cypress).
  • Good understanding of bundling and compilation (e.g., webpack, rollup, vite, esbuild)
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows (GitLab CI or similar), private registries, and secure artifact handling.
  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and drive change. Experience in a leadership role is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills facilitating effective collaboration with a cross functional team.
  • Committed to writing high-quality code and continuously improving projects.
  • Strong understanding of development best practices, including design patterns, testing methodologies, and an agile development process.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

descriptionBody:

• Design, build, and maintain full-stack applications that power core products and platforms.

• 5+ years of full-stack development experience.

  • Solid backend experience in Go or a similar language.

  • Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and drive resolution.
    •

  • Experience with React Native for mobile development.
  • Background in gaming, payments, or commerce systems.
  • Experience in adtech or offer monetization platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms.
  • Experience with Redis or other in-memory data stores.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse, Postgres, or other analytical/OLAP/OLTP databases.
  • Prior experience working on internal platforms or developer-facing tools.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android platforms.

  • Implement best practices for mobile development, including code review, testing strategies, and CI/CD processes.

  • Deliver high-quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Build scalable and maintainable features within the existing application architecture.

  • Collaborate with product and design teams to implement technical solutions that meet business goals.

  • Integrate mini-apps and virtual currency systems with the Xsolla App ecosystem.

  • Work with cross-functional teams, including developers, QA engineers, and project managers.

  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

  • Communicate effectively across distributed teams.

    •  
    Architecture & Design
     

    • Design and implement scalable application architecture for React Native mobile apps with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.

    • Lead architectural decisions around shared code strategies between React web and React Native mobile platforms.

    • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.

    • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.

    • Build and maintain a robust monorepo infrastructure using tools like Nx, Turborepo, or similar.

    • Configure and optimize build pipelines, dependency management, and workspace configurations.

    • Implement efficient caching strategies and incremental builds to optimize CI/CD performance.

    • Manage versioning, publishing, and dependency relationships between packages.

    • Design and develop a comprehensive shared component library that works seamlessly across React and React Native.

    • Create platform-agnostic business logic, utilities, and services that can be consumed by both web and mobile.

    • Build tooling and documentation to enable other developers to easily leverage shared code.

    • Implement adaptive components with platform-specific implementations where necessary while maintaining a unified API.

    • Establish patterns for sharing type definitions, hooks, contexts, and state management across platforms.

• 5+ years of experience in mobile application development with a strong focus on React Native.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Proven track record of delivering commercial mobile applications from concept to launch.

  • Proficiency in React Native and JavaScript/TypeScript, with knowledge of native modules (Swift/Kotlin) as a plus.

  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture patterns and state management.

  • Experience with third-party integrations and APIs.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a results-driven approach.

  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Familiarity with gaming ecosystems and virtual currency platforms is a plus.

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst who is analytically rigorous, strategically minded, and a collaborative problem-solver to join our Advertising & Rewards division. The Senior Product Analyst will collaborate with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Business Stakeholders by using data-driven insights to inform the design and optimization of Xsolla’s B2C apps/websites. The ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders will be key to your success in this role. • Own product and data analysis for Xsolla's new B2C apps and websites, generating insights that optimize how we reward and engage users.
  • Conduct descriptive, diagnostic, and prescriptive analysis — including product funnel mapping, user cohort analysis, and behavioral data modeling — to improve user experience and drive growth and engagement.
  • Define KPIs for the product and build automated dashboards, reports, and models that enable smarter, faster decision-making across the business.
  • Design, orchestrate, and analyze multivariate product experiments to drive growth, improve existing features, and test new areas of opportunity.
  • Apply advanced analytics techniques — including machine learning — to uncover player insights, forecast economic trends, and support monetization strategies, while ensuring outputs remain interpretable and actionable for stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with data, product, engineering, and business stakeholders to build business cases and forecasts for new feature development.

• BA/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or another quantitative field.5+ years of experience in quantitative analysis, preferably within games or other consumer-facing apps.
  • Fluency in SQL with demonstrated ability to work with highly dimensional and complex datasets.
  • Strong proficiency with Statsig or comparable A/B testing platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with Looker, Tableau, or other BI/data visualization tools.
  • Strong proficiency with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or other product analytics platforms.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, startup-like environment.

• Experience with machine learning or predictive modeling in a product context.
  • Background in advertising, offerwall, or performance marketing analytics.
  • Familiarity with user acquisition and monetization metrics in mobile or free-to-play games.

1. Lead product planning and design for the company's white-label app store platform, enabling clients to rapidly build and operate their own branded app marketplaces on a shared platform infrastructure — covering core modules including the end-user app store, developer console, and operations backend.
2. Own the configurable product design of the white-label app store, including brand theming, page layout, content structure, operational rules, and role-based permissions — improving platform reusability and project delivery efficiency.
3. Design and optimize the full app lifecycle — from onboarding and submission for review, to publishing, search and recommendation exposure, and download conversion.
4. Engage with clients, business development, and operations teams to gather requirements; identify common needs across clients in areas such as app distribution, content operations, and campaign configuration; and consolidate reusable functional modules and configuration solutions to reduce repetitive custom development.
5. Collaborate with engineering teams to build out platform capabilities including multi-tenancy, permission frameworks, configuration backends, and module reuse — supporting continuous platform scaling and multi-project delivery.
6. Design developer platform capabilities including developer onboarding, app submission and review, version management, data dashboards, and settlement/revenue sharing modules.
7. Work with operations teams to design featured collections, campaign pages, and resource slot scheduling — supporting key app distribution initiatives and growth targets.
8. Partner with the monetization team on capabilities such as advertising, in-app purchase revenue sharing, and subscription services — exploring platform monetization models.
9. Track developments in the app store landscape, Android ecosystem, and overseas distribution markets; continuously refine product strategy in line with business growth.

1. Bachelor's degree or above; majors in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields preferred.
2. 5–8 years of product management experience in internet products; experience with platform products, app stores, content distribution platforms, open platforms, or SaaS platforms preferred.
3. Proven experience designing complex backend systems or platform-type products; ability to independently lead product planning and delivery across multiple user roles and modules.
4. Strong familiarity with core app distribution flows, including app review, search ranking, recommendation mechanisms, chart strategies, and growth conversion.
5. Familiarity with white-label products, multi-tenant architecture, permission systems, or configurable backend design; hands-on project experience preferred.
6. Strong requirements analysis and abstraction skills; able to balance client-specific customization needs against scalable platform solutions.
7. Strong cross-functional communication and project execution skills; able to drive delivery in collaboration with engineering, QA, operations, and business teams.
8. Data-driven mindset; able to identify product issues through data analysis and drive iterative improvements.
9. Solid English reading and writing proficiency; experience with overseas markets or multilingual products preferred.
 

Bonus Points

1. Experience with Google Play, Huawei AppGallery, Xiaomi App Store, or similar platforms.
2. Experience with the Android ecosystem, SDK platforms, or open platform products.
3. Experience with advertising platforms, monetization products, or growth products.
4. Experience with products targeting overseas markets, multiple regions, or multilingual user bases.
5. Familiarity with app review processes, compliance requirements, or security risk management.

About You

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who excels at consumer app product strategy and hands-on execution to join our Advertising & Rewards division. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to drive product excellence for a new gaming-oriented B2C mobile app  — from shaping roadmap strategy to hands-on day-to-day execution.

Strong analytical and communication skills are essential, along with experience in gaming, loyalty, rewarded advertising and/or commerce. The ability to balance short-term wins with long-term strategy, bridging the gap between engineering, user experience and commercial needs will be key to your success in this role. If you're passionate about building high-performance consumer applications  and love creating rewards and commerce solutions that deliver real value to gamers, game developers, and advertisers alike, we would love to hear from you!

About Us

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with the company’s Head of Product, Ads B2C as part of a new and growing B2C product team

  • Help to evolve and optimize our recently-launched consumer app

  • Design and leverage analytics and A/B testing to monitor app performance, tune mechanics, optimize conversion and identify new features to impact KPIs

  • Create and maintain product roadmaps, feature backlogs and product documentation such as PRDs, user stories, user flows, logic flows, and functional specifications, leveraging AI tools where value-added

  • Anticipate bottlenecks, provide support for escalation management, make tradeoffs, balance the business needs versus technical and resource constraints

  • Conduct ongoing competitive analyses of other products to identify ways to differentiate and improve user experience

  • Collaborate with executive leadership to identify opportunities for growth, innovation, and differentiation

  • Identify user needs and opportunities through data analysis, surveys, interviews, and other quantitative and qualitative methods

  • Work closely with engineering and design teams to ensure high-quality execution and iteration

  • Collaborate with operations, customer support, marketing and legal teams

  • Obsess over user experience, user motivation and conversion optimization

Qualifications & Skills - Required

  • 5+ years of product management experience dealing with Consumer Apps and Conversion Optimization, ideally with exposure to gaming, loyalty, rewarded advertising and/or commerce 

  • Highly data-driven (e.g. adept at using analytics and A/B testing to drive product decisions)

  • Strong vision and creativity (i.e., natural ability to generate ideas, think laterally to solve problems), but also...

  • Highly organized and pragmatic (i.e., can efficiently analyze tradeoffs, adept at prioritization and time management with limited resources and high uncertainty)

  • Proven track record deploying game mechanics to influence user behavior (direct experience with mobile free-to-play games a huge plus)

  • Deep experience with A/B testing and related tools such as Statsig

  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, Productboard, and other product lifecycle tools

  • Strong experience with product analytics tools like Amplitude or Mixpanel.

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present ideas clearly to both technical and business stakeholders

Qualifications & Skills - Nice to Have

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to optimize product management and development

  • Basic to advanced SQL proficiency

  • UX design experience

  • Experience working with data teams on personalization and ML efforts

 

Salary Range

ABOUT YOU
 
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to help define, build, and scale the Xsolla Money Account. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex problem spaces, enjoys working hands-on with engineering and partners, and is motivated by turning ambiguity into shipped, high-quality products.
The Xsolla Money Account is a strategic initiative to build embedded financial services for gamers, creators, and developers. The product spans wallet capabilities, card issuing, payouts, and future financial tools that remove friction from how value moves across the gaming ecosystem. Sitting at the intersection of fintech and gaming, the Money Account enables new business models, creator monetization, and deeper player engagement.
You will own critical parts of the Money Account roadmap and execution, working closely with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable financial products. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, the ability to navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities, and consistent follow-through from concept through launch and iteration. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys staying close to execution and takes pride in seeing complex work through to completion.
This is a high-impact product area operating in a dynamic, evolving environment with meaningful technical, regulatory, and partner complexity. The opportunity is to shape foundational financial infrastructure that will scale globally and directly influence how money flows through the gaming economy.

lists.content:
Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Contribute to the Money Account product strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.

  • Identify opportunities to expand wallet, issuing, payouts, and related financial capabilities for gamers and creators.

  • Balance user experience, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and partner constraints when shaping solutions.

    • Product Definition & Delivery

  • Translate product strategy into clear, high-quality PRDs that provide context, rationale, and actionable requirements.

  • Partner closely with UX/UI designers to craft intuitive, trustworthy end-to-end user experiences.

  • Work with engineering teams using Jira and Confluence to manage scope, priorities, and delivery.

  • Drive features from ideation through build, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, compliance, legal, finance, marketing, and customer support teams.

  • Communicate goals, tradeoffs, and timelines clearly to maintain alignment across stakeholders.

  • Support internal enablement by helping teams understand new features, user flows, and operational impacts.

    • Partner & Platform Engagement

  • Work with external partners such as wallet providers, issuing banks, BaaS platforms, and card networks.

  • Participate in partner discussions to clarify requirements, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to evaluations of vendors, platforms, and capabilities that support the Money Account roadmap.

    • Data, Insights, and Iteration

  • Define and monitor key product metrics related to onboarding, engagement, and usage.

  • Use data, user feedback, and partner insights to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.

  • Continuously refine products based on performance and evolving customer needs.

Experience & Background

  • 8–12+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance, or e-commerce.

  • Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional Fintech products from concept to launch.

  • Experience with digital wallets, card issuing, payouts, or BaaS platforms.

  • Strong technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams and APIs.

    • Product & Execution Skills

  • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured product requirements and execution plans.

  • Strong project management and execution skills, including the ability to plan work, manage timelines and dependencies, track action items, and proactively surface risks or blockers.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong proficiency with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, and related tools) to manage backlogs, document requirements, maintain execution visibility, and support prioritization and planning workflows.

  • Data-informed mindset with the ability to use metrics to guide decisions.

    • Collaboration & Mindset

  • Collaborative, humble, and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and reassessing assumptions as new information emerges.

  • A proactive, can‑do mindset with a bias toward action—someone who rolls up their sleeves, tackles problems head-on, and looks for ways to move work forward rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and change, maintaining momentum even as priorities evolve.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with a bias toward ownership and execution.

• Familiarity with fraud management, risk, chargebacks, or compliance considerations.

  • Experience in gaming, digital goods, and creator platforms.

lists.content:
Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Contribute to the Money Account product strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.

  • Identify opportunities to expand wallet, issuing, payouts, and related financial capabilities for gamers and creators.

  • Balance user experience, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and partner constraints when shaping solutions.

    • Product Definition & Delivery

  • Translate product strategy into clear, high-quality PRDs that provide context, rationale, and actionable requirements.

  • Partner closely with UX/UI designers to craft intuitive, trustworthy end-to-end user experiences.

  • Work with engineering teams using Jira and Confluence to manage scope, priorities, and delivery.

  • Drive features from ideation through build, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, compliance, legal, finance, marketing, and customer support teams.

  • Communicate goals, tradeoffs, and timelines clearly to maintain alignment across stakeholders.

  • Support internal enablement by helping teams understand new features, user flows, and operational impacts.

    • Partner & Platform Engagement

  • Work with external partners such as wallet providers, issuing banks, BaaS platforms, and card networks.

  • Participate in partner discussions to clarify requirements, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to evaluations of vendors, platforms, and capabilities that support the Money Account roadmap.

    • Data, Insights, and Iteration

  • Define and monitor key product metrics related to onboarding, engagement, and usage.

  • Use data, user feedback, and partner insights to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.

  • Continuously refine products based on performance and evolving customer needs.

Experience & Background

  • 8–12+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance, or e-commerce.

  • Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional Fintech products from concept to launch.

  • Experience with digital wallets, card issuing, payouts, or BaaS platforms.

  • Strong technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams and APIs.

    • Product & Execution Skills

  • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured product requirements and execution plans.

  • Strong project management and execution skills, including the ability to plan work, manage timelines and dependencies, track action items, and proactively surface risks or blockers.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong proficiency with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, and related tools) to manage backlogs, document requirements, maintain execution visibility, and support prioritization and planning workflows.

  • Data-informed mindset with the ability to use metrics to guide decisions.

    • Collaboration & Mindset

  • Collaborative, humble, and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and reassessing assumptions as new information emerges.

  • A proactive, can‑do mindset with a bias toward action—someone who rolls up their sleeves, tackles problems head-on, and looks for ways to move work forward rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and change, maintaining momentum even as priorities evolve.

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude with a bias toward ownership and execution.

• Familiarity with fraud management, risk, chargebacks, or compliance considerations.

  • Experience in gaming, digital goods, and creator platforms.

descriptionPlain:
ABOUT YOU
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have.
The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites.
You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

lists.content:
ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services designed to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA studios, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in a strong belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in its mission to bring opportunities together and continually make new resources available to creators.

Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as a merchant of record and has helped more than 1,500 game developers reach more players and grow their businesses worldwide. With more paths to profit and ways to win, developers have everything they need to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

  • A consumer smart wallet built on account abstraction, so players can own and use digital items without managing keys or gas themselves.

  • Integrations with an external wallet-infrastructure partner and with Xsolla's existing player products.

  • Taking the wallet from testnet to a production launch on an Ethereum-compatible Layer 2.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end test strategy for the wallet: sign-in, wallet creation, asset display, send and receive, and transaction confirmation on Xsolla ZK.

  • Test account-abstraction flows: UserOperation construction and validation, bundler submission, EntryPoint execution, paymaster-sponsored gas, and session-key and signer behaviour.

  • Test signing end to end: personal_sign and EIP-712 typed-data requests through the EIP-1193 provider, and signature validation by the wallet contract (ERC-1271), including before the wallet is deployed.

  • Verify counterfactual deployment: that the address derived with CREATE2 from the factory, salt and init code matches the deployed wallet contract, on a forked or local chain, before it reaches mainnet.

  • Deploy, call and inspect smart contracts from the command line to set up test state and reproduce defects.

  • Use chain-forking and simulation tools to test against real network state without real funds, and trace failed transactions to their root cause.

  • Validate the full transaction lifecycle — broadcast, inclusion, reorgs and finality — and its failure paths: reverts, failed UserOperations, insufficient balance, expired session keys, ownership changing mid-flight, and bundler errors.

  • Reconcile what players see with on-chain state: indexer balances and NFT ownership against contract state, including when the indexer lags or diverges, and the account-to-wallet records behind Xsolla ID.

  • Test transfers and approvals across ERC-20, ERC-721 and ERC-1155, including partial ERC-1155 quantities and safe transfers into contract wallets.

  • Write acceptance tests for a partner's wallet SDK and contracts, and report integration defects with the evidence needed to route them to the right owner.

  • Build and maintain automation: Playwright for wallet UI flows, and scripted on-chain checks in TypeScript that run in CI.

  • Set up and maintain AI tooling in the test repositories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: rules, context, harness) so QA and engineers use it effectively.

  • Plan and run testnet-to-mainnet release validation, including contract deployment verification and post-deploy smoke checks.

  • Work with security on signing, key handling and key-export flows, and test for signature replay, typed-data phishing and token approval abuse.

  • Mentor QA engineers who are new to Web3, and raise on-chain testing practice across teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field (or international equivalent).

  • 6+ years in software testing or quality engineering, including 2+ years of hands-on testing on EVM-based products.

    • Web3 libraries and tooling

    • Hands-on work with viem and wagmi (ethers.js also counts): reading contract state, sending transactions, and decoding events and revert errors from test code.

    • Deploying and interacting with smart contracts from the command line with Foundry (forge, cast, anvil) or Hardhat; able to read Solidity well enough to know what a contract is meant to do.

    • Chain forking and simulation with Anvil, Tenderly or similar tools, and tracing a failed transaction from a block explorer or transaction trace down to its revert reason.

      • On-chain fundamentals

      • A working model of Ethereum transactions: nonces, gas, receipts, events and logs, reverts, reorgs and finality — including the gap between a sequencer confirmation and L1 finality on a rollup — and how indexers can lag or diverge from chain state.

      • Token standards: ERC-20, ERC-721 and ERC-1155 mechanics, including approvals and the safe-transfer callbacks a contract wallet must implement to receive NFTs.

      • How wallet signers work: EOAs, embedded wallets and smart accounts; personal_sign (EIP-191) and typed data (EIP-712); the EIP-1193 provider; signature validation for contract accounts (ERC-1271).

      • Practical understanding of account abstraction (ERC-4337): UserOperations, bundlers, the EntryPoint, paymasters, counterfactual deployment and CREATE2 address derivation, and session keys.

      • Wallet security basics: signature replay and cross-chain replay, phishing via typed-data signing, and token approval abuse — and how to design test cases that catch them.

        • Testing and automation

        • Test automation in TypeScript or JavaScript, and UI automation with Playwright or a similar framework.

        • API testing over REST and JSON-RPC, including bundler methods (eth_sendUserOperation, eth_estimateUserOperationGas, eth_getUserOperationReceipt), and basic SQL.

        • Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for test design, automation and review — generating test cases from specs, analysing logs and transaction traces — including configuring them for a repository.

          • Ways of working

          • Able to run complex, high-impact testing with minimal supervision and wide latitude for independent judgment.

          • Excellent written and spoken English, and proven collaboration in cross-functional teams across time zones.

            • Preferred

            • Experience on a wallet, decentralized exchange or NFT marketplace.

            • ZK Stack and zk-rollups: native account abstraction and paymaster flows on zkSync-family chains, and how finality, gas and EVM compatibility differ from Ethereum mainnet.

            • Embedded, MPC or white-label wallet SDK integrations.

            • EIP-7702 delegation, and ERC-6492 signature validation for accounts that are not yet deployed.

            • Writing on-chain tests in Foundry, including fuzz and invariant tests; familiarity with OpenZeppelin contracts and the ERC-4337 reference implementation.

            • Consumer-scale or gaming products.

            • Reading Go.

            • Load and performance testing of high-volume transaction flows, for example with k6.

BENEFITS

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

lists.content:
Credit Card Payment Processing
Implement and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant services handling real-time authorization, batch clearing, and settlement workflows.
Build and maintain integrations with acquiring banks, card networks (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), payment gateways, fraud providers, and tokenization services.
Implement resilient routing logic, retry strategies, and failover mechanisms across card network connections.
  • Ensure transaction idempotency and correct state management across the full card payment lifecycle.
  • Support 3D Secure (3DS2) and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows.
  • Implement and maintain card vaulting and tokenization solutions in line with PCI DSS requirements.
    • Alternative Payment Methods (APMs)
  • Build and maintain integrations with a broad range of APMs, including digital wallets (PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay), bank transfers (ACH, SEPA, instant bank pay), buy now pay later (BNPL) providers, prepaid and voucher methods, and regional local payment methods across key markets.
  • Design flexible, extensible integration patterns that allow rapid onboarding of new payment methods and providers.
  • Handle the unique lifecycle requirements of each payment method — including asynchronous notifications, delayed confirmations, refund flows, and currency/settlement nuances.
  • Collaborate with Product to evaluate and prioritize new APM integrations based on market coverage and player demand.
    • Reconciliation & Financial Integrity
  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation pipelines that match authorization, clearing, and settlement records across both card and APM payment rails.
  • Reconcile internal ledgers against acquirer, network, and PSP reports; detect and surface mismatches, duplicates, and missing transactions.
  • Develop safeguards to prevent revenue leakage and ensure ledger consistency at scale.
  • Ensure all financial systems are audit-ready and compliant with internal financial controls.
    • Reporting, Monitoring & Alerting
    Build and maintain payment reporting systems covering authorization rates, settlement reconciliation, interchange and fee breakdowns, APM conversion rates, and chargeback/dispute metrics.
  • Implement threshold-based alerting for authorization rate drops, decline pattern anomalies, settlement mismatches, volume spikes, and chargeback ratio changes across all payment methods.
  • Contribute to internal financial dashboards supporting cost optimization, risk monitoring, and financial performance visibility.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for payment-critical systems.
    • Compliance & Security
  • Build systems compliant with PCI DSS, card network operating regulations, data encryption and tokenization standards, and regional mandates.
  • Contribute to secure handling of sensitive payment data across card and APM flows.
  • Support audit processes and financial compliance reviews as required.
    • Fraud & Dispute Management
  • Integrate with fraud detection and risk scoring systems across card and APM payment flows.
  • Implement chargeback and dispute workflow components, including evidence submission and representment support.
  • Build safeguards and monitoring for fraud pattern detection across payment methods.
    • Engineering Excellence
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and correctness.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions.
  • Contribute to best practices for distributed systems design, observability, incident response, and financial data integrity.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a high-trust, high-accountability engineering culture.

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on PHP and Go (Golang) tech stacks
  • at least 2+ years working on payment processing systems in production
  • Hands-on experience with card payment flows: authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and chargebacks.
  • Experience integrating with or building against one or more APM providers (wallets, bank transfers, BNPL, local payment methods).
  • Solid understanding of the four-party (Visa/Mastercard) and three-party (Amex/Discover) models, including interchange, BIN logic, MCC codes, AVS, CVV, and 3DS/SCA.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems: idempotency, eventual consistency, fault tolerance, and high availability.
  • Proficiency in designing and consuming RESTful and/or event-driven APIs in a payments context.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS and payment data security fundamentals.
  • Strong debugging and incident response skills in complex, high-volume financial systems.
    •  
    NICE TO HAVE
     
  • Experience at a PSP, acquirer, issuer, payment gateway, or fintech platform.
  • Familiarity with global payments and cross-border processing, including FX, local settlement, and regulatory considerations.
  • Experience at high transaction volumes (10M+ monthly transactions).
  • Exposure to authorization rate optimization and intelligent payment routing.
  • Familiarity with the gaming, digital goods, or e-commerce payments landscape.
  • Experience with audit processes and financial compliance reviews.

In your first 6 months, you will have:
  • Delivered meaningful improvements to at least one area of the card or APM payment stack — whether a new integration, a reconciliation improvement, or a reliability/observability uplift.
  • Demonstrated deep ownership of a payment domain area, proactively identifying and resolving gaps in reliability, correctness, or coverage.
  • Built strong working relationships with the Tech Lead, PM, and cross-functional stakeholders across Finance and Risk.
  • Contributed to engineering practices that raise the quality bar for the broader payments team.
