• Serve as Incident Commander for major incidents — coordinating cross-functional response teams, driving investigation, making escalation decisions, and ensuring incidents are resolved within SLA targets.

  • Own all incident communications: draft and send clear, timely updates to senior leadership, Customer Success, and partner/customer contacts throughout the incident lifecycle, and manage customer-facing status page updates (status.xsolla.com).

  • Facilitate blameless Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) for major incidents — leading root cause identification, assigning corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines, and tracking them to closure.

  • During non-incident periods, proactively analyze incident trends, recurring issues, and production bugs — identify patterns, create Problem tickets, and report findings and recommendations to product and engineering teams on a regular cadence.

  • Enforce the incident management framework across the organization, including the severity model, priority matrix, SLA targets, escalation procedures, and deployment readiness gates.

  • Oversee and mentor the Operations Engineer on your shift — coaching on triage, investigation, runbook execution, and documentation quality while conducting regular knowledge transfer sessions to build depth across the service portfolio.

  • Produce shift handoff reports and deliver regular operational reporting: incident trends, KPI performance (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR), SLA adherence, proactive detection rate, and repeat incident analysis.

  • Audit service catalogue completeness on a regular cadence and govern JIRA Service Management workflows for incident, PIR, and problem management.

  • Cover for the Operations Engineer role during vacations, absences, breaks, or surge incidents — including monitoring, triage, ticket creation, and runbook execution. Participate in weekend on-call rotation for major incidents.

• 6+ years of experience in incident management, SRE, NOC leadership, or technical operations in a production environment supporting high-availability, high-transaction systems (payments, e-commerce, SaaS, or gaming platforms preferred).

  • Proven incident management experience — coordinating multi-team response, making real-time escalation decisions, and communicating with executive stakeholders under pressure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — ability to draft clear, concise executive updates at 3 AM under pressure, facilitate blameless PIRs, present operational metrics to senior leadership, and communicate incident status to customers and partners with clarity and professionalism.

  • Strong ITIL foundation — understanding of incident, problem, and change management lifecycles with practical experience implementing or operating ITIL-aligned workflows.

  • Technical depth across the observability stack — ability to read and interpret logs, traces, and metrics in Datadog (or equivalent: Grafana, Splunk, New Relic). Understanding of APM, SLOs, error budgets, burn-rate alerting, and synthetic monitoring.

  • Hands-on experience with incident tooling: Datadog, PagerDuty or OpsGenie, JIRA or JIRA Service Management, Slack, and Confluence.

  • Analytical mindset — ability to identify trends, patterns, and recurring issues from incident data and translate them into actionable recommendations for product and engineering teams.

  • Experience with SLA/SLO-driven operations where MTTD, MTTA, and MTTR are measured, reported, and improved.

  • Experience with or strong interest in AI/ML-assisted operations: anomaly detection, alert correlation, predictive alerting, automated remediation, or self-healing automation.

  • Comfort with 24x7 shift-based operations as part of a follow-the-sun model with handoff overlaps. Weekend on-call (rotating) for critical severities is required.

• Experience in the gaming, payments, or fintech industry, and with customer/partner-facing incident communications and status page management.

  • JIRA Service Management administration experience (workflows, SLA timers, automation rules) and familiarity with Datadog Service Catalog, scorecards, and SLOs — especially burn-rate alerts and multi-window SLOs.

  • Experience building an operations function from scratch — defining processes, writing runbooks, establishing governance cadences. Background in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), microservices architecture, or distributed systems. ITIL certification (Foundation or higher) is a plus.

• Serve as Incident Commander for major incidents — coordinating cross-functional response teams, driving investigation, making escalation decisions, and ensuring incidents are resolved within SLA targets.

  • Own all incident communications: draft and send clear, timely updates to senior leadership, Customer Success, and partner/customer contacts throughout the incident lifecycle, and manage customer-facing status page updates (status.xsolla.com).

  • Facilitate blameless Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) for major incidents — leading root cause identification, assigning corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines, and tracking them to closure.

  • During non-incident periods, proactively analyze incident trends, recurring issues, and production bugs — identify patterns, create Problem tickets, and report findings and recommendations to product and engineering teams on a regular cadence.

  • Enforce the incident management framework across the organization, including the severity model, priority matrix, SLA targets, escalation procedures, and deployment readiness gates.

  • Oversee and mentor the Operations Engineer on your shift — coaching on triage, investigation, runbook execution, and documentation quality while conducting regular knowledge transfer sessions to build depth across the service portfolio.

  • Produce shift handoff reports and deliver regular operational reporting: incident trends, KPI performance (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR), SLA adherence, proactive detection rate, and repeat incident analysis.

  • Audit service catalogue completeness on a regular cadence and govern JIRA Service Management workflows for incident, PIR, and problem management.

  • Cover for the Operations Engineer role during absences, breaks, or surge incidents. Participate in weekend on-call rotation for major incidents.

• 6+ years of experience in incident management, SRE, NOC leadership, or technical operations in a production environment supporting high-availability, high-transaction systems (payments, e-commerce, SaaS, or gaming platforms preferred).

  • Proven incident management experience — coordinating multi-team response, making real-time escalation decisions, and communicating with executive stakeholders under pressure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — ability to draft clear, concise executive updates at 3 AM under pressure, facilitate blameless PIRs, present operational metrics to senior leadership, and communicate incident status to customers and partners with clarity and professionalism.

  • Strong ITIL foundation — understanding of incident, problem, and change management lifecycles with practical experience implementing or operating ITIL-aligned workflows.

  • Technical depth across the observability stack — ability to read and interpret logs, traces, and metrics in Datadog (or equivalent: Grafana, Splunk, New Relic). Understanding of APM, SLOs, error budgets, burn-rate alerting, and synthetic monitoring.

  • Hands-on experience with incident tooling: Datadog, PagerDuty or OpsGenie, JIRA or JIRA Service Management, Slack, and Confluence.

  • Analytical mindset — ability to identify trends, patterns, and recurring issues from incident data and translate them into actionable recommendations for product and engineering teams.

  • Experience with SLA/SLO-driven operations where MTTD, MTTA, and MTTR are measured, reported, and improved.

  • Experience with or strong interest in AI/ML-assisted operations: anomaly detection, alert correlation, predictive alerting, automated remediation, or self-healing automation.

  • Comfort with 24x7 shift-based operations as part of a follow-the-sun model with handoff overlaps. Weekend on-call (rotating) for critical severities is required.

• Experience in the gaming, payments, or fintech industry.

  • Experience with customer/partner-facing incident communications and status page management.

  • JIRA Service Management administration experience: workflows, SLA timers, automation rules, queues, and permissions.

  • Familiarity with Datadog Service Catalog, scorecards, and SLOs — especially burn-rate alerts and multi-window SLOs.

  • Experience building an operations function from scratch — defining processes, writing runbooks, establishing governance cadences.

  • Background in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), microservices architecture, or distributed systems.

  • ITIL certification (Foundation or higher) is a plus but not required.

description:
About Xsolla

Xsolla is a global video game commerce company that provides the tools and infrastructure the gaming industry relies on to build, distribute, and monetize games. Working with developers and publishers of every size, from independent studios to the largest franchises in the world, Xsolla operates as a merchant of record and processes payments across more than 200 countries and territories, supporting over 1,000 payment methods, 130 currencies, and 25 languages. Its platform spans the full game lifecycle, including web shops, Pay Station, Login, Launcher, the In-Game Store, and a broad suite of LiveOps and monetization tools.

 

The Capital Markets Grou

The Capital Markets Group (CMG) sits within Xsolla's Global Strategic Initiatives function and operates as the firm's institutional capital platform. The group originates, structures and executes financing and investment solutions across games and interactive entertainment.

The group operates multiple investment vehicles spanning debt financing and credit markets, alongside special situations and principal investment strategies serving the interactive entertainment ecosystem. These activities are supported by a proprietary market intelligence system, a global events and convening program, and a governed institutional relationship platform covering LPs, sovereign investors, family offices, banks and intermediaries across the Americas, MENA, APAC and Europe.

CMG operates from hubs in Los Angeles, New York, the Middle East and Singapore. The group is in its foundation stage: hires at every level join a live deal environment with executive sponsorship, meaningful ownership and the mandate to build a durable franchise rather than inherit one.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

lists.content:
Xsolla is seeking a Vice President, Investor Relations and Capital Formation to run the investor relations engine of the Capital Markets Group across its fund platform: owning the institutional relationship platform, the capital formation funnel from segmentation and tiering through outreach, nurture, diligence and close, and the investor communications and reporting that keep LPs informed and engaged.

The corporate title for this seat is Vice President. The role manages the Analyst, Capital Markets Intelligence and CRM, and offers a clear path to senior leadership of the group's investor relations function.

The Vice President, Investor Relations and Capital Formation will be based in Los Angeles, CA, Xsolla's headquarters, in office, and will report to the Group Head of Capital Markets (SVP, Global Strategic Initiatives), with a dotted line to the fund principals. Travel is approximately 15 to 25 percent, primarily for roadshows and priority industry events. This is a full time position.

 

Expressions of Interest

Xsolla welcomes confidential conversations with qualified candidates and trusted introductions. Please direct expressions of interest, together with a resume and a short note on relevant experience, to the Xsolla Talent Acquisition team via the application button linked below.

As Vice President, Investor Relations and Capital Formation, you will run the investor relations engine for the group's fund platform. You will own the relationship platform and the capital formation funnel end to end: segmentation and tiering, outreach and nurture, diligence and data room, investor communications and reporting. The role suits a candidate who has run fund marketing operations at an institutional standard and wants to build that function, and the team behind it, from the foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Capital Formation Operations

  • Run the funnel. Run the capital formation funnel end to end, from segmentation and tiering through outreach, nurture, diligence and close.

  • Manage diligence. Manage DDQs, the data room and subscription documents in partnership with fund counsel and fund administrators.

  • Coordinate roadshows. Plan and coordinate multi region roadshows and own the master investor calendar.

  • Support onboarding. Support investor onboarding, including KYC and AML processes, with fund administrators and counsel.

    • Investor Relations and Communications

    • Produce investor materials. Produce introductory materials, quarterly updates, announcements and invitations, with all communications cleared through Legal and fund counsel.

    • Prepare senior coverage. Ensure meeting briefings are prepared for senior coverage and that commitments made in meetings are tracked through to completion.

    • Integrate convening. Integrate the group's global events and convening program into the capital formation funnel.

      • Relationship Platform and Data Governance

      • Own the platform. Serve as Salesforce system administrator and data owner for the relationship platform, including schema, tiering and scoring, deduplication, enrichment and the interaction logging standard.

      • Report on the funnel. Produce funnel, coverage and data hygiene reporting for the weekly pipeline call and the monthly executive readout, and maintain the KPI dashboard.

      • Control access. Manage access controls and permissions on the relationship platform.

        • Team and Control

        • Develop the Analyst. Manage and develop the Analyst, Capital Markets Intelligence and CRM.

        • Operate within the rules. Operate within private placement marketing constraints and approval workflows, and maintain audit ready records across investor activity.

Experience

  • 6 to 10 years of experience in investor relations, capital formation, private placement or fund marketing operations at an alternative asset manager, placement agent, fund administrator or investment bank.

  • Hands-on experience running DDQs, data rooms and subscription processes.

  • Exposure to multiple alternative strategies, such as credit, special situations and private equity, is preferred, as is exposure to gaming, entertainment or technology investing.

    • Domain Expertise

    • Working knowledge of fund marketing compliance and private placement rules.

    • Familiarity with institutional reporting standards and standard DDQ formats is preferred.

      • Skills and Competencies

      • Demonstrated accountability as a CRM administrator and data owner, ideally in Salesforce.

      • Experience with marketing automation tools and data providers such as Preqin or PitchBook is preferred.

      • Exceptional business writing skills.

      • Strong organization across multiple time zones and workstreams.

      • Discretion with confidential information and a high degree of ethics and integrity.

        • Education and Credentials

        • A bachelor's degree is required.

        • The SIE, Series 7 and Series 63 licenses and the CAIA designation are preferred.

          • Work Authorization

          • Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

About You
We’re looking for a Web3 Fullstack Engineer to build the layer where web2 and web3 meet. Our mission is seamless web2 ↔ web3 integration — letting players and developers interact with digital items and move them through their full lifecycle (mint, own, trade, transfer, redeem, retire) without ever having to think about which side of the chain they’re on. You’ll work across the whole stack: wallet-connected frontends, high-throughput backend services, and the smart contract and indexing layers that make on-chain items feel as fast and familiar as anything in web2.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. A player buying an item with a credit card, a game granting an in-game asset, and a marketplace settling a peer-to-peer trade should all resolve to the same coherent item model — regardless of whether the item lives in a database, a custodial wallet, or on-chain. Making that experience invisible to the end user, and reliable for the developer, is the core of the job.
You care about product quality and developer experience as much as protocol correctness. You’re comfortable owning a feature end to end, reasoning about trust and custody boundaries, and making pragmatic calls about what belongs on-chain versus off-chain.
 
About Us
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com

lists.content:
Build Seamless Web2 ↔ Web3 Integration — Design and ship the flows that let users move between traditional accounts/payments and on-chain wallets without friction: custodial and non-custodial wallets, account abstraction, gasless transactions, and fiat on-ramps.

Own the Digital Item Lifecycle — Build the systems behind item mint, ownership, transfer, trading, and redemption — keeping on-chain state and off-chain records consistent, auditable, and fast.

Develop Fullstack Features — Deliver end to end across wallet-connected frontends, backend services, and the smart contract / indexing layer that powers item ownership and turnover.

Model Items & Ownership — Design data models and APIs that represent items uniformly whether they live off-chain, in a custodial wallet, or on-chain, and keep them in sync.

Ensure Reliability of Value Flows — Anything that moves items or money must be correct under failure: idempotency, reconciliation, replay safety, and clear recovery paths.

Integrate Blockchains & Marketplaces — Interact with EVM chains, token standards, indexers, and marketplace/settlement flows; abstract their differences behind clean internal interfaces.

Collaborate Across Teams — Work with product, security, payments, and game-facing teams to turn business needs into well-scoped technical plans, and document decisions so they stand on their own.

Web3 & Digital Assets

Web2 ↔ Web3 Integration — Hands-on experience bridging traditional systems with on-chain ones: wallet onboarding, custodial vs. non-custodial trade-offs, account abstraction, gasless/relayed transactions.

EVM & Smart Contracts — Working knowledge of EVM chains and Solidity, including reading, integrating with, and reasoning about the safety of contracts.

Token & Item Standards — Practical understanding of ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155, and how they map to real game items, ownership, and transfers.

On-chain / Off-chain Sync — Experience keeping blockchain state consistent with off-chain databases: indexing, event ingestion, reorg handling, and reconciliation.

Frontend Engineering

TypeScript & React — Strong TypeScript and React skills for building responsive, production-grade interfaces.

Wallet Integration — Experience with wallet connectivity and web3 client libraries (e.g. wagmi, viem, ethers.js, WalletConnect) and embedded/social login wallets.

Backend Engineering

Backend Services — Solid backend skills in Node.js and Go: clean APIs, concurrency, and performance under load.

Distributed Systems — Experience with distributed systems and their trade-offs (consistency, availability, failure modes), especially where correctness of value transfer matters.

Data & Infrastructure

PostgreSQL — Schema design, query optimization, and migrations at scale.

Kubernetes — Deploying, operating, and debugging services in a k8s environment.

Message Streaming — Kafka or NATS — event-driven patterns, consumer groups, at-least-once delivery.

Git & CI/CD — Git and modern CI/CD practices.

Domain Context

Gaming Industry Experience — Experience building or operating platforms for game developers, publishers, or players — especially anything touching in-game items, economies, or ownership.

• Experience building NFT marketplaces, item trading, or secondary-market / settlement systems
  • Familiarity with blockchain indexing tooling (The Graph, custom indexers) and node/RPC infrastructure
  • Experience with account abstraction (ERC-4337), smart wallets, or paymaster/relayer setups
  • Background in payments or fiat on-ramp integration bridging traditional commerce and crypto
  • Experience with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, etc.) or cross-chain / bridging patterns
  • Familiarity with security and compliance relevant to digital assets: custody, key management, audit logging, KYC/AML touchpoints
  • Contributions to open-source web3, wallet, or tooling projects
  • Hands-on, up-to-date experience with modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and accelerating day-to-day engineering work
